5.3.131.m: Then, having stepped across northward and set down the two offering spoons in their proper place, having cut off the portion for the brahmán priest, he cuts off the iḍā.

5.4.131.s: upahūtāyām iḍāyām agnīdha ādadhāti ṣaḍavattam | prāśnanti
5.4.131.d: उपहूतायाम् इडायाम् अग्नीध आदधाति षडवत्तम् । प्राश्नन्ति
5.4.131.m: When the iḍā has been invoked, he gives to the āgnīdhra priest the sixfold cutting. / They consume [their portions].

5.4.131.s: mārjayante | athāha brahmaṇe prāśitraṃ parihara | iti pari prāśitram̐ haranti |
5.4.131.d: मार्जयन्ते । अथाह ब्रह्मणे प्राशित्रं परिहर । इति परि प्राशित्रँ हरन्ति ।
5.4.131.m: They cleanse themselves. / Then he says: "Carry around the portion for the brahmán priest!" / They carry around the portion for the brahmán priest.

5.4.131.s: anv apo 'nu vedena brahmabhāgam athānvāhāryaṃ yācati tasmin prathamajaṃ vatsaṃ dadāty udvāsayanty etad dhavir ucchiṣṭam
5.4.131.d: अन्व् अपो ऽनु वेदेन ब्रह्मभागम् अथान्वाहार्यं याचति तस्मिन् प्रथमजं वत्सं ददात्य् उद्वासयन्त्य् एतद् धविर् उच्छिष्टम्
5.4.131.m: Following the water, following the broom, [he carries] the brahmán's share. / Then he requests the dakṣiṇā-rice. / For that, he gives a first-born calf. They remove this oblation remainder.

5.4.131.s: atha saṃpraiṣam āha brahman prasthāsyāmaḥ samidham ādhāyāgnīd agnīn sakṛtsakṛt saṃmṛḍḍhi | iti |
5.4.131.d: अथ संप्रैषम् आह ब्रह्मन् प्रस्थास्यामः समिधम् आधायाग्नीद् अग्नीन् सकृत्सकृत् संमृड्ढि । इति ।
5.4.131.m: Then he gives the direction: "O brahmán, we shall set forth! O āgnīdhra priest, having placed a kindling stick, cleanse the fires once each!"

5.4.131.s: athādhvaryuḥ pṛṣadājyaṃ vihatya juhvām̐ samānīyātyākramyāśrāvyāha devān yaja | iti
5.4.131.d: अथाध्वर्युः पृषदाज्यं विहत्य जुह्वाँ समानीयात्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह देवान् यज । इति
5.4.131.m: Then the adhvaryu priest, having stirred the clotted ghee, pours it together into the juhū spoon, steps across, makes the call, and says: "Offer to the gods!"

5.4.131.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti yaja yaja | iti navānūyājān iṣṭvodaṅṅ atyākramya yathāyatanam̐ srucau sādayitvā vājavatībhyām̐ srucau vyūhati
5.4.131.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति यज यज । इति नवानूयाजान् इष्ट्वोदङ्ङ् अत्याक्रम्य यथायतनँ स्रुचौ सादयित्वा वाजवतीभ्याँ स्रुचौ व्यूहति
5.4.131.m: When the vaṣaṭ call is made, he offers, [and at the other calls with] "Offer! Offer!"; having offered the nine after-offerings, stepping across northward, having set down the two offering spoons in their proper place, he parts the two offering spoons with the two verses containing the word vāja.

5.4.132.s: śaṃyunā prastaraparidhi saṃprakīrya samprasrāvya srucau vimucya |
5.4.132.d: शंयुना प्रस्तरपरिधि संप्रकीर्य सम्प्रस्राव्य स्रुचौ विमुच्य ।
5.4.132.m: Having touched together the grass bundle and enclosing stick with the Śaṃyu formula, having poured out the residue together, and having unyoked the two offering spoons,

5.4.132.s: atha kam̐saṃ vā camasaṃ vānājyaliptaṃ yācati
5.4.132.d: अथ कँसं वा चमसं वानाज्यलिप्तं याचति
5.4.132.m: he then asks for a bronze bowl or wooden cup not smeared with ghee.

5.4.132.s: tam antarvedi nidhāya tasmin barhiṣi viṣiñcan vājinam ānayann āha vājibhyo 'nubrūhi | iti |
5.4.132.d: तम् अन्तर्वेदि निधाय तस्मिन् बर्हिषि विषिञ्चन् वाजिनम् आनयन्न् आह वाजिभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि । इति ।
5.4.132.m: Having set it down within the altar, pouring out the whey onto that sacrificial grass, bringing it forward, he says: "Recite for the Vājins!"
Having stepped across, having made the call, he says: "Offer to the Vājins!"

5.4.132.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti vājibhyaḥ svāhā | iti | anuvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā harati bhakṣam |
5.4.132.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति वाजिभ्यः स्वाहा । इति । अनुवषट्कृते हुत्वा हरति भक्षम् ।
5.4.132.m: When the vaṣaṭ call is made, he offers with "To the Vājins, svāhā!" / Having offered when the secondary vaṣaṭ call is made, he carries away the drink portion.

5.4.132.s: sa yāvanta ṛtvijas teṣūpahavam iṣṭvā yajamāna eva pratyakṣaṃ bhakṣayati yan me retaḥ prasicyate yan ma āpyāyate yad vā jāyate punaḥ | yad vā me pratitiṣṭhati tena mā vājinaṃ kuru tena mā retasvinaṃ kuru tena mā śivam āviśa "tasya te vājipītasya" "vājibhiḥ pītasya" | iti vā "madhumata upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi" | iti
5.4.132.d: स यावन्त ऋत्विजस् तेषूपहवम् इष्ट्वा यजमान एव प्रत्यक्षं भक्षयति यन् मे रेतः प्रसिच्यते यन् म आप्यायते यद् वा जायते पुनः । यद् वा मे प्रतितिष्ठति तेन मा वाजिनं कुरु तेन मा रेतस्विनं कुरु तेन मा शिवम् आविश "तस्य ते वाजिपीतस्य" "वाजिभिः पीतस्य" । इति वा "मधुमत उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि" । इति
5.4.132.m: Having sought permission among as many officiating priests as there are, the sacrificer himself visibly consumes it with: "Whatever seed of mine is poured out, whatever increases or is born again, / or whatever is established in me, through that make me vigorous; through that make me full of seed; through that enter me as auspicious! Of that, drunk by the Vājins"—or "drunk by the courser—sweet, invited, being invited I consume."

5.4.132.s: athādhvaryuḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyaṅṅ ādrutya patnīḥ saṃyājya prāṅ etya dhruvām āpyāyya trīṇi pāśubandhikāni samiṣṭayajūm̐ṣi juhoti yajña yajñaṃ gaccha | eṣa te yajño yajñapate devā gātuvidas | iti |
5.4.132.d: अथाध्वर्युः प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आद्रुत्य पत्नीः संयाज्य प्राङ् एत्य ध्रुवाम् आप्याय्य त्रीणि पाशुबन्धिकानि समिष्टयजूँषि जुहोति यज्ञ यज्ञं गच्छ । एष ते यज्ञो यज्ञपते देवा गातुविदस् । इति ।
5.4.132.m: Then the adhvaryu priest, having turned sunwise, running west, having performed the offerings to the wives, going east, having replenished the dhruvā spoon, offers three samiṣṭayajus formulas pertaining to animal sacrifice with: 'O sacrifice, go to the sacrifice,' 'This is your sacrifice, O lord of sacrifice,' 'O gods that find the way.'
Then, having proceeded with the full-cup libations and the steps of Viṣṇu, [the sacrificer] releases the vow.

5.4.132.s: atha paurṇamāsavaimṛdhābhyām iṣṭvā yajamānāyatana upaviśya treṇyā śalalyā lohitāyasasya ca kṣureṇa śīrṣan ni ca vartayate pari ca vapate | ṛtam eva parameṣṭi | ṛtaṃ nātyeti kiṃ cana | ṛte samudra āhitas | ṛte bhūmir iyam̐ śritā || agnis tigmena śociṣā tapa ākrāntam uṣṇihā | śiras tapasy āhitam | vaiśvānarasya tejasā || ṛtenāsya nivartaye satyena parivartaye | tapasāsyānuvartaye śivenāsyopavartaye śagmenāsyābhivartaye || śīrṣṇas tad ṛtam | tat satyam | tad vratam | tac chakeyam | tena śakeyam | tena rādhyāsam iti purastād evāgre 'tha dakṣiṇato 'tha paścād athottarato 'thopariṣṭāt
5.4.132.d: अथ पौर्णमासवैमृधाभ्याम् इष्ट्वा यजमानायतन उपविश्य त्रेण्या शलल्या लोहितायसस्य च क्षुरेण शीर्षन् नि च वर्तयते परि च वपते । ऋतम् एव परमेष्टि । ऋतं नात्येति किं चन । ऋते समुद्र आहितस् । ऋते भूमिर् इयँ श्रिता ॥ अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा तप आक्रान्तम् उष्णिहा । शिरस् तपस्य् आहितम् । वैश्वानरस्य तेजसा ॥ ऋतेनास्य निवर्तये सत्येन परिवर्तये । तपसास्यानुवर्तये शिवेनास्योपवर्तये शग्मेनास्याभिवर्तये ॥ शीर्ष्णस् तद् ऋतम् । तत् सत्यम् । तद् व्रतम् । तच् छकेयम् । तेन शकेयम् । तेन राध्यासम् इति पुरस्ताद् एवाग्रे ऽथ दक्षिणतो ऽथ पश्चाद् अथोत्तरतो ऽथोपरिष्टात्
5.4.132.m: Then, having offered with the full-moon and Vaimṛdha [offerings], having sat down in the sacrificer's place, [the sacrificer] parts [the hair] downwards and shaves around [the head] with a three-spotted porcupine quill and a copper razor, with: 'Parameṣṭhin is the cosmic order itself; nothing surpasses cosmic order. In cosmic order the ocean is placed; on cosmic order this earth rests. Agni with fierce radiance, ascetic heat entered through the Uṣṇih meter; the head is placed in ascetic heat by the splendor of Vaiśvānara. By cosmic order I part [the hair] downwards for him; by truth I shave [the hair] around for him; by ascetic heat I part it along for him; by auspiciousness I bring it down for him; by power I bring it toward him.' [Touching the hair] of the head [with]: 'That is cosmic order,' 'That is truth,' 'That is the vow,' 'May I be able to do that,' 'Through that may I be able,' 'Through that may I succeed'—first in the front, then to the south, then to the west, then to the north, and then on the top.

5.4.133.s: saṃtiṣṭhante vaiśvadevahavīm̐ṣi saṃvatsarīṇām̐ svastim āśāste | ity āśāste ||
5.4.133.d: संतिष्ठन्ते वैश्वदेवहवीँषि संवत्सरीणाँ स्वस्तिम् आशास्ते । इत्य् आशास्ते ॥
5.4.133.m: The Vaiśvadeva oblations are completed. He invokes a blessing with: 'He invokes a blessing lasting for a full year.'

5.5.133.s: athātaś caturṣu māseṣu varuṇapraghāsahavirbhir yakṣyamāṇo bhavati
5.5.133.d: अथातश् चतुर्षु मासेषु वरुणप्रघासहविर्भिर् यक्ष्यमाणो भवति
5.5.133.m: Now then, after four months, he is going to sacrifice with the oblations of the Varuṇapraghāsa.

5.5.133.s: sa upakalpayate treṇīm̐ śalalīṃ lohitāyasasya ca kṣuraṃ catuṣṭayāni puroḍāśakapālāni pañca carusthālīs tāvanti mekṣaṇāni dvayaṃ payaḥ pṛṣadājyāya ca dadhi havirātañcanāya ca śamīparṇakarīrasaktūn aiṣīkam̐ śūrpaṃ manāgupataptānāṃ yavānām avāñjanapiṣṭānāṃ pratipūruṣaṃ karambhapātrāṇi |
5.5.133.d: स उपकल्पयते त्रेणीँ शललीं लोहितायसस्य च क्षुरं चतुष्टयानि पुरोडाशकपालानि पञ्च चरुस्थालीस् तावन्ति मेक्षणानि द्वयं पयः पृषदाज्याय च दधि हविरातञ्चनाय च शमीपर्णकरीरसक्तून् ऐषीकँ शूर्पं मनागुपतप्तानां यवानाम् अवाञ्जनपिष्टानां प्रतिपूरुषं करम्भपात्राणि ।
5.5.133.m: He procures: a three-spotted porcupine quill, a copper razor, four sets of potsherds for the puroḍāśas, five pot-dishes for caru, as many stirring-sticks, milk of two kinds, curd for the speckled ghee and for curdling the oblation, flour of barley mixed with śamī leaves and karīra fruits, a winnowing basket made of reed, and bowls of barley-mash made of slightly heated barley ground without winnowing, one bowl for each person [in the family].

5.5.133.s: teṣām eva meṣīṃ ca meṣaṃ ca kurvanti śṛṅgavān meṣo bhavaty aśṛṅgā meṣī
5.5.133.d: तेषाम् एव मेषीं च मेषं च कुर्वन्ति शृङ्गवान् मेषो भवत्य् अशृङ्गा मेषी
5.5.133.m: Out of these very [mash-bowls] they make a ewe and a ram; the ram has horns, the ewe is hornless.

5.5.133.s: tau śuklābhir ūrṇābhiḥ saṃpracchannau bhavatas | dvāv adhvaryū
5.5.133.d: तौ शुक्लाभिर् ऊर्णाभिः संप्रच्छन्नौ भवतस् । द्वाव् अध्वर्यू
5.5.133.m: The two are covered with white wool. There are two adhvaryu priests.

5.5.133.s: dvayāni yajñapātrāṇi dvayam idhmābarhis | dve vedī tayoḥ pāśubandhikīvottarā dārśapaurṇamāsikīva dakṣiṇā
5.5.133.d: द्वयानि यज्ञपात्राणि द्वयम् इध्माबर्हिस् । द्वे वेदी तयोः पाशुबन्धिकीवोत्तरा दार्शपौर्णमासिकीव दक्षिणा
5.5.133.m: There are duplicate sacrificial utensils, duplicate kindling wood and sacrificial grass, two altars; of the two, the northern one is like that of an animal sacrifice, the southern one like that of the new and full moon sacrifices.

5.5.133.s: te paścātsame purastādviṣame pṛthamātrād vedī asaṃbhinne bhavatas |
5.5.133.d: ते पश्चात्समे पुरस्ताद्विषमे पृथमात्राद् वेदी असंभिन्ने भवतस् ।
5.5.133.m: They are level at the west, different at the east, and separated by a span without blending together.

5.5.133.s: athāsyaitad ahardvayā vatsā apākṛtā bhavanti marudbhyo varuṇāya | iti
5.5.133.d: अथास्यैतद् अहर्द्वया वत्सा अपाकृता भवन्ति मरुद्भ्यो वरुणाय । इति
5.5.133.m: Then on this day two calves are driven away [from their mothers], with: 'For the Maruts, for Varuṇa.'

5.5.133.s: dvayaṃ payo dohayitvopavasati sāṃnāyyasya vāvṛtā tūṣṇīṃ vā |
5.5.133.d: द्वयं पयो दोहयित्वोपवसति सांनाय्यस्य वावृता तूष्णीं वा ।
5.5.133.m: Having caused the two kinds of milk to be milked, he fasts according to the procedure of the curd-and-milk oblation or silently.

5.5.133.s: atha prātarhute 'gnihotre pṛṣṭhyām̐ stīrtvāpaḥ praṇīya nirvapati | āgneyam aṣṭākapālam iti pañca saṃcarāṇi | aindrāgnam ekādaśakapālaṃ mārutīm āmikṣāṃ vāruṇīm āmikṣāṃ kāyam ekakapālam iti
5.5.133.d: अथ प्रातर्हुते ऽग्निहोत्रे पृष्ठ्याँ स्तीर्त्वापः प्रणीय निर्वपति । आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालम् इति पञ्च संचराणि । ऐन्द्राग्नम् एकादशकपालं मारुतीम् आमिक्षां वारुणीम् आमिक्षां कायम् एककपालम् इति
5.5.133.m: Then, the agnihotra having been offered in the morning, having laid out the pṛṣṭhyā line, having brought forward the waters, he scoops out [the materials for the five common offerings]: 'For Agni on eight potsherds'—these are the five common offerings—[and adds]: 'For Indra-Agni on eleven potsherds, curd-clot for the Maruts, curd-clot for Varuṇa, [a cake] on one potsherd for Ka.'

5.5.134.m: With the call 'Make ready the oblation,' he releases speech.

5.5.134.s: samānaṃ karmā paryagnikaraṇāt | atraitāni karambhapātrāṇy abhiparyagnikurvanti meṣīṃ ca meṣaṃ ca śamīparṇakarīrasaktūn aiṣīkam̐ śūrpam iti
5.5.134.d: समानं कर्मा पर्यग्निकरणात् । अत्रैतानि करम्भपात्राण्य् अभिपर्यग्निकुर्वन्ति मेषीं च मेषं च शमीपर्णकरीरसक्तून् ऐषीकँ शूर्पम् इति
5.5.134.m: The rite is the same up to the carrying around of fire. At this point, they carry fire around these bowls of barley-mash, the ewe and the ram, the flour with śamī leaves and karīra fruits, and the reed winnowing basket.

5.5.134.s: tvacaṃ puroḍāśānāṃ grāhayitvā śrapayitvābhivāsya prāṅ etyāpy ebhyo ninīya stambayajuṣī haratas |
5.5.134.d: त्वचं पुरोडाशानां ग्राहयित्वा श्रपयित्वाभिवास्य प्राङ् एत्याप्य् एभ्यो निनीय स्तम्बयजुषी हरतस् ।
5.5.134.m: Having caused a crust to form on the puroḍāśas, having baked them, having covered them with embers, having gone east, and having poured water for these [ancestors], the two [priests] carry the stambayajus.

5.5.134.s: adhvaryur evottarasyāṃ vedyām̐ harati pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇasyām |
5.5.134.d: अध्वर्युर् एवोत्तरस्यां वेद्याँ हरति प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणस्याम् ।
5.5.134.m: The adhvaryu priest carries [it] on the northern altar, the pratiprasthātṛ priest on the southern [altar].

5.5.134.s: tayor harator adhvaryuḥ pūrva eti punarāyatoḥ pratiprasthātā pūrva eti |
5.5.134.d: तयोर् हरतोर् अध्वर्युः पूर्व एति पुनरायतोः प्रतिप्रस्थाता पूर्व एति ।
5.5.134.m: Of the two carrying, the adhvaryu priest goes first; of the two returning, the pratiprasthātṛ priest goes first.
This is the well-known procedure for cake-offerings.

5.5.134.s: trir yajuṣā tūṣṇīṃ caturtham | pūrvau parigrāhau parigṛhṇītas |
5.5.134.d: त्रिर् यजुषा तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् । पूर्वौ परिग्राहौ परिगृह्णीतस् ।
5.5.134.m: Three times with the yajus formula, silently the fourth time, they trace the first boundary-lines.

5.5.134.s: adhvaryur eva karaṇaṃ japaty uddhatas | uddhatābhyām āgnīdhras trir harati
5.5.134.d: अध्वर्युर् एव करणं जपत्य् उद्धतस् । उद्धताभ्याम् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिर् हरति
5.5.134.m: The adhvaryu priest alone murmurs the formula; from the dug-out earth of both [altars], the āgnīdhra priest carries [the earth] away three times.

5.5.134.s: yad āgnīdhras trir haraty adhvaryur eva cātvālasyāvṛtā cātvālaṃ parilikhati |
5.5.134.d: यद् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिर् हरत्य् अध्वर्युर् एव चात्वालस्यावृता चात्वालं परिलिखति ।
5.5.134.m: While the āgnīdhra priest carries [earth] three times, the adhvaryu priest traces the pit according to the procedure for the pit.

5.5.134.s: uttaraveder āvṛtottaravediṃ nivapaty uttaranābhim utsādyāgner āvṛtā dvāvagnī praṇayatas |
5.5.134.d: उत्तरवेदेर् आवृतोत्तरवेदिं निवपत्य् उत्तरनाभिम् उत्साद्याग्नेर् आवृता द्वावग्नी प्रणयतस् ।
5.5.134.m: According to the procedure for the high-altar he pours out the high-altar; having raised the upper navel, following the procedure for fire, the two priests bring forward the two fires.

5.5.134.s: adhvaryur evottarasyāṃ vedyām agniṃ nidhāyādhvarāhutibhir abhijuhoti
5.5.134.d: अध्वर्युर् एवोत्तरस्यां वेद्याम् अग्निं निधायाध्वराहुतिभिर् अभिजुहोति
5.5.134.m: The adhvaryu priest, having laid down the fire on the northern altar, makes offerings with the adhvara libations.
The pratiprasthātṛ priest, having laid down the fire on the southern [altar], makes offerings silently.

5.5.134.s: agnivaty uttarau parigrāhau parigṛhya yoyupitvā tiryañcau sphyau stabdhvādhvaryur eva saṃpraiṣam āha prokṣaṇīr āsādayatam idhmābarhiṣī upasādayatam | sruvau ca srucaś ca saṃmṛṣṭaṃ tūṣṇīṃ pṛṣadājyagrahaṇīm | patnīm̐ saṃnahya | ājyābhyāṃ ca dadhnā codetam iti |
5.5.134.d: अग्निवत्य् उत्तरौ परिग्राहौ परिगृह्य योयुपित्वा तिर्यञ्चौ स्फ्यौ स्तब्ध्वाध्वर्युर् एव संप्रैषम् आह प्रोक्षणीर् आसादयतम् इध्माबर्हिषी उपसादयतम् । स्रुवौ च स्रुचश् च संमृष्टं तूष्णीं पृषदाज्यग्रहणीम् । पत्नीँ संनह्य । आज्याभ्यां च दध्ना चोदेतम् इति ।
5.5.134.m: Having traced the second boundary-lines with fire [present], having smoothed [the altar], having placed the two wooden swords crosswise, the adhvaryu priest alone gives the direction: 'Set down the sprinkling waters; set down near the two sets of kindling wood and sacrificial grass; cleanse the two dipping-ladles and the offering-ladles, and silently the ladle for speckled ghee; having girded the wife, come up with both portions of ghee and with the curd.'

5.5.134.s: āhṛtāsu prokṣaṇīṣūdasya sphyau mārjayitvedhmābarhiṣī upasādya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyañcāv ādrutya sruvau ca srucaś ca saṃmṛṣṭas tūṣṇīṃ pṛṣadājyagrahaṇīm |
5.5.134.d: आहृतासु प्रोक्षणीषूदस्य स्फ्यौ मार्जयित्वेध्माबर्हिषी उपसाद्य प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यञ्चाव् आद्रुत्य स्रुवौ च स्रुचश् च संमृष्टस् तूष्णीं पृषदाज्यग्रहणीम् ।
5.5.134.m: When the sprinkling waters have been brought, having raised the two wooden swords, having wiped them, having set down near the two sets of kindling wood and sacrificial grass, having turned sunwise, having run west, the two priests cleanse the two dipping-ladles and the offering-ladles, and silently the ladle for speckled ghee.

5.5.135.m: Having girded the wife, they come up with both portions of ghee and with the curd.

5.5.135.s: ājye ca prokṣaṇīś cotpūya prasiddhaṃ pṛṣadājyavanty evājyāny adhvaryur uttarasyāṃ vedyāṃ gṛhṇīte
5.5.135.d: आज्ये च प्रोक्षणीश् चोत्पूय प्रसिद्धं पृषदाज्यवन्त्य् एवाज्यान्य् अध्वर्युर् उत्तरस्यां वेद्यां गृह्णीते
5.5.135.m: Having purified the two portions of ghee and the sprinkling waters, in the prescribed manner the adhvaryu priest takes the portions of ghee along with speckled ghee on the northern altar;
the pratiprasthātṛ priest takes those of the new and full moon sacrifices on the southern [altar].

5.6.135.s: atha prokṣaṇībhir upottiṣṭhatas | idhmau prokṣatas | vedī prokṣatas |
5.6.135.d: अथ प्रोक्षणीभिर् उपोत्तिष्ठतस् । इध्मौ प्रोक्षतस् । वेदी प्रोक्षतस् ।
5.6.135.m: Then the two priests step near with the sprinkling waters; they sprinkle the two bundles of kindling wood; they sprinkle the two altars;

5.6.135.s: barhiṣī prokṣatas | barhiṣī āsanne prokṣyopaninīya purastāt prastarau gṛhṇītaḥ
5.6.135.d: बर्हिषी प्रोक्षतस् । बर्हिषी आसन्ने प्रोक्ष्योपनिनीय पुरस्तात् प्रस्तरौ गृह्णीतः
5.6.135.m: they sprinkle the two sets of sacrificial grass; having sprinkled the two sets of sacrificial grass when brought near, and having poured water down, they take the two grass bundles from the east.

5.6.135.s: pañcavidham evādhvaryur uttarasyāṃ vedyāṃ barhi stṛṇāti
5.6.135.d: पञ्चविधम् एवाध्वर्युर् उत्तरस्यां वेद्यां बर्हि स्तृणाति
5.6.135.m: The adhvaryu priest strews the sacrificial grass in five layers on the northern altar;

5.6.135.s: trividhaṃ pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇasyām atha prastarapāṇī prāñcāv abhisṛpya kārṣmaryamayān paridhīn paridhattas |
5.6.135.d: त्रिविधं प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणस्याम् अथ प्रस्तरपाणी प्राञ्चाव् अभिसृप्य कार्ष्मर्यमयान् परिधीन् परिधत्तस् ।
5.6.135.m: the pratiprasthātṛ priest in three layers on the southern [altar]. Then, with the grass bundles in hand, having crept forward facing east, the two priests lay down enclosing sticks made of kārṣmarya wood.
They lay down dividing blades crosswise; on the dividing blades, the two grass bundles;

5.6.135.s: prastarayor juhvau barhiṣor itarās | etā asadan | iti samabhimṛśya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyañcāv ādravato dakṣiṇata evādhvaryur uttarataḥ pratiprasthātā |
5.6.135.d: प्रस्तरयोर् जुह्वौ बर्हिषोर् इतरास् । एता असदन् । इति समभिमृश्य प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यञ्चाव् आद्रवतो दक्षिणत एवाध्वर्युर् उत्तरतः प्रतिप्रस्थाता ।
5.6.135.m: on the two grass bundles, the two juhū ladles; on the sacrificial grass, the other ladles. Having touched them with 'These have sat down,' having turned sunwise, they run west—the adhvaryu priest along the south, the pratiprasthātṛ priest along the north.

5.6.135.s: anupūrvam̐ havīm̐ṣy udvāsayatas | āgneyaprabhṛtīny evādhvaryur udvāsayati prasiddham aindrāgnāt |
5.6.135.d: अनुपूर्वँ हवीँष्य् उद्वासयतस् । आग्नेयप्रभृतीन्य् एवाध्वर्युर् उद्वासयति प्रसिद्धम् ऐन्द्राग्नात् ।
5.6.135.m: They remove the oblations in order: the adhvaryu priest removes those beginning with that for Agni in the prescribed manner up to that for Indra-Agni;

5.6.135.s: mārutīṃ pratiprasthātā kam̐se vā camase vāmikṣāṃ vyuddhṛtya tasyāṃ meṣīm avadadhāti |
5.6.135.d: मारुतीं प्रतिप्रस्थाता कँसे वा चमसे वामिक्षां व्युद्धृत्य तस्यां मेषीम् अवदधाति ।
5.6.135.m: the pratiprasthātṛ priest, having scooped out the curd-clot for the Maruts into a bronze vessel or into a wooden cup, places the ewe into it;

5.6.136.m: then upon it he scatters flour with śamī leaves and karīra fruits, and curd-clot;
having brought whey, he then pours ghee over it.

5.6.136.s: vāruṇīm adhvaryus tathaiva kam̐se vā camase vāmikṣāṃ vyuddhṛtya tasyāṃ meṣam avadadhāti |
5.6.136.d: वारुणीम् अध्वर्युस् तथैव कँसे वा चमसे वामिक्षां व्युद्धृत्य तस्यां मेषम् अवदधाति ।
5.6.136.m: The adhvaryu priest in the same manner, having scooped out the curd-clot for Varuṇa into a bronze vessel or into a wooden cup, places the ram into it;
then upon it he scatters flour with śamī leaves and karīra fruits, and curd-clot;

5.6.136.s: vājinam ānīyāthābhighārayati tathaikakapālam udvāsya bahv ānīyāviḥpṛṣṭhaṃ karoti |
5.6.136.d: वाजिनम् आनीयाथाभिघारयति तथैककपालम् उद्वास्य बह्व् आनीयाविःपृष्ठं करोति ।
5.6.136.m: having brought whey, he then pours ghee over it. Likewise, having removed [the cake] on one potsherd, having poured much [ghee], he leaves its surface exposed.

5.6.136.s: athaitāni saṃparigṛhyāntarvedy āsādyatas | āgneyaprabhṛtīny evādhvaryur uttarasyāṃ vedyām āsādayati prasiddham aindrāgnāt |
5.6.136.d: अथैतानि संपरिगृह्यान्तर्वेद्य् आसाद्यतस् । आग्नेयप्रभृतीन्य् एवाध्वर्युर् उत्तरस्यां वेद्याम् आसादयति प्रसिद्धम् ऐन्द्राग्नात् ।
5.6.136.m: Then, having taken hold of these [oblations], they are placed within the altar. The adhvaryu priest places the oblations beginning with that for Agni on the northern altar in the known manner up to that for Indra-Agni;
the pratiprasthātṛ priest [places] the curd-mixture for the Maruts on the southern [altar];
the adhvaryu priest [places] the curd-mixture for Varuṇa and the cake on one potsherd for Ka on the northern [altar].

5.6.136.s: tathaivotakare vā viśaye vā vājine adhvaryur eva nirmanthyasyāvṛtā nirmanthyena carati
5.6.136.d: तथैवोतकरे वा विशये वा वाजिने अध्वर्युर् एव निर्मन्थ्यस्यावृता निर्मन्थ्येन चरति
5.6.136.m: Likewise, either on the rubbish heap or in an indeterminate place, [are placed the vessels] for the whey. The adhvaryu priest alone performs the rite of churned fire with the churned fire,

5.7.136.s: athedhmāt samidham ādadāna āha | agnaye samidhyamānāyānubrūhi | iti |
5.7.136.d: अथेध्मात् समिधम् आददान आह । अग्नये समिध्यमानायानुब्रूहि । इति ।
5.7.136.m: Then, taking a kindling stick from the kindling wood, he says: "Recite for Agni being kindled!"

5.7.136.s: abhyādhatta idhmau pari samidhau śinaṣṭas | vedābhyām upavājayatas |
5.7.136.d: अभ्याधत्त इध्मौ परि समिधौ शिनष्टस् । वेदाभ्याम् उपवाजयतस् ।
5.7.136.m: Both put on the two bundles of kindling wood; they leave two kindling sticks over; they fan [the two fires] with the two brooms.

5.7.136.s: anūktāsu sāmidhenīṣu sruvābhyām āghārāv āghārayatas | adhvaryur eva saṃpraiṣam āha | agnīd agnīm̐s tristriḥ saṃmṛḍḍhi | iti
5.7.136.d: अनूक्तासु सामिधेनीषु स्रुवाभ्याम् आघाराव् आघारयतस् । अध्वर्युर् एव संप्रैषम् आह । अग्नीद् अग्नीँस् त्रिस्त्रिः संमृड्ढि । इति
5.7.136.m: When the sāmidhenī verses have been recited, they pour the two preliminary libations with the two dipping ladles. The adhvaryu priest alone gives the direction: "O Agnīdh, sweep around the fires three times each!"

5.7.136.d: संमृष्ट उत्तरो ऽग्निर् भवत्य् असंमृष्टो दक्षिणस् ।
5.7.136.m: The northern fire is swept around, [while] the southern remains unswept.

5.7.136.s: atha pratiprasthātā patnīṃ pṛcchati patni kas te jāras | iti |
5.7.136.d: अथ प्रतिप्रस्थाता पत्नीं पृच्छति पत्नि कस् ते जारस् । इति ।
5.7.136.m: Then the pratiprasthātṛ priest asks the wife: "Wife, who is your lover?"

5.7.136.s: asau | iti taṃ varuṇo gṛhṇātu | iti nirdiśati
5.7.136.d: असौ । इति तं वरुणो गृह्णातु । इति निर्दिशति
5.7.136.m: "Such-a-one," she says; "May Varuṇa seize him!" he specifies.

5.7.136.s: yaj jāram̐ santaṃ na brūyāt priyaṃ jñātim̐ rundhyāt | asau me jāras | iti nirdiśet |
5.7.136.d: यज् जारँ सन्तं न ब्रूयात् प्रियं ज्ञातिँ रुन्ध्यात् । असौ मे जारस् । इति निर्दिशेत् ।
5.7.136.m: "If she should not name a lover who exists, she would obstruct a dear kinsman. Let her declare, 'Such-a-one is my lover.'
By declaring him alone she causes him to be seized by Varuṇa's noose"—so says the brāhmaṇa passage.

5.7.136.s: atraitāni karambhapātrāṇy abhiparyagnikṛtāny aiṣīke śūrpe samupya patnyai prayacchati
5.7.136.d: अत्रैतानि करम्भपात्राण्य् अभिपर्यग्निकृतान्य् ऐषीके शूर्पे समुप्य पत्न्यै प्रयच्छति
5.7.136.m: Then, having carried fire around these karambha-dishes, having poured them into a winnowing basket made of reed, he hands them to the wife.

5.7.137.s: tāni patnī śīrṣann adhinidhatte | athaināṃ dakṣiṇayā dvāropaniṣkramayya dakṣiṇenānvāhāryapacanaṃ dakṣiṇenobhe vedī parītya prācīm udānayan vācayati praghāsyān havāmahe maruto yajñavāhasaḥ karambheṇa sajoṣasas | iti |
5.7.137.d: तानि पत्नी शीर्षन्न् अधिनिधत्ते । अथैनां दक्षिणया द्वारोपनिष्क्रमय्य दक्षिणेनान्वाहार्यपचनं दक्षिणेनोभे वेदी परीत्य प्राचीम् उदानयन् वाचयति प्रघास्यान् हवामहे मरुतो यज्ञवाहसः करम्भेण सजोषसस् । इति ।
5.7.137.m: The wife places them on her head. Then, having led her out by the southern door, having gone around the south of the anvāhāryapacana fire and around the south of both altars, leading her forward facing east, he makes her say: "We invoke the greedy Maruts, carriers of the sacrifice, finding pleasure in the karambha!"

5.7.137.s: atha dakṣiṇam agnim agreṇa purastāt pratyaṅmukhās tiṣṭhanty uttara evādhvaryur dakṣiṇo yajamāno dakṣiṇā patnī |
5.7.137.d: अथ दक्षिणम् अग्निम् अग्रेण पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुखास् तिष्ठन्त्य् उत्तर एवाध्वर्युर् दक्षिणो यजमानो दक्षिणा पत्नी ।
5.7.137.m: Then they stand in front of the southern fire facing west: the adhvaryu priest indeed on the north, the sacrificer on the south, and the wife on the [farther] south.

5.7.137.s: atraitāni karambhapātrāṇi patnī yajamānāya prayacchati tāni yajamānaḥ śīrṣann adhinidhatte |
5.7.137.d: अत्रैतानि करम्भपात्राणि पत्नी यजमानाय प्रयच्छति तानि यजमानः शीर्षन्न् अधिनिधत्ते ।
5.7.137.m: Then the wife hands these karambha-dishes to the sacrificer. The sacrificer places them on his head.
Then [the hotṛ] recites the invitatory verse:

5.8.137.s: mo ṣū ṇa indra pṛtsu devāstu sma te śuṣminn avayā | mahī hy asya mīḍhuṣo yavyā | haviṣmato maruto vandate gīs | iti |
5.8.137.d: मो षू ण इन्द्र पृत्सु देवास्तु स्म ते शुष्मिन्न् अवया । मही ह्य् अस्य मीढुषो यव्या । हविष्मतो मरुतो वन्दते गीस् । इति ।
5.8.137.m: "May not [the gods], O Indra, be in the contests! O mighty one, be an averter of our [misfortune]! For great is the barley-harvest of this bounteous one; the song of the offering worshipper praises the Maruts!"

5.8.137.s: ubhau yājyāṃ patnī ca yad grāme yad araṇye yat sabhāyāṃ yad indriye | yac chūdre yad arya enaś cakṛmā vayam | yad ekasyādhi dharmaṇi tasyāvayajanam asi svāhā | iti |
5.8.137.d: उभौ याज्यां पत्नी च यद् ग्रामे यद् अरण्ये यत् सभायां यद् इन्द्रिये । यच् छूद्रे यद् अर्य एनश् चकृमा वयम् । यद् एकस्याधि धर्मणि तस्यावयजनम् असि स्वाहा । इति ।
5.8.137.m: Both [the sacrificer] and the wife [recite] the offering verse: "Whatever sin we have committed in the village, in the forest, in the assembly, with our senses, whatever against a śūdra, whatever against an Arya, whatever against the duty of one person—you are its atonement, svāhā!"

5.8.137.s: atraitad aiṣīkam̐ śūrpam agnāv anupraharati | api vādbhir abhyukṣya bhuñjate
5.8.137.d: अत्रैतद् ऐषीकँ शूर्पम् अग्नाव् अनुप्रहरति । अपि वाद्भिर् अभ्युक्ष्य भुञ्जते
5.8.137.m: Then he throws this reed winnowing basket into the fire; or, having sprinkled it with water, they use it.

5.8.137.s: vyavayato 'dhvaryur anumantrayate | akran karma karmakṛtaḥ saha vācā mayobhuvā | devebhyaḥ karma kṛtvā | astaṃ preta sudānavas | iti |
5.8.137.d: व्यवयतो ऽध्वर्युर् अनुमन्त्रयते । अक्रन् कर्म कर्मकृतः सह वाचा मयोभुवा । देवेभ्यः कर्म कृत्वा । अस्तं प्रेत सुदानवस् । इति ।
5.8.137.m: As they step apart, the adhvaryu priest recites over them: "The workers have done the work, along with the speech giving comfort; having done the work for the gods, go home, O generous ones!"

5.8.137.s: atha pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇam agnim̐ saṃmārṣṭi | ubhau srucyāv āghārāv āghārayatas |
5.8.137.d: अथ प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणम् अग्निँ संमार्ष्टि । उभौ स्रुच्याव् आघाराव् आघारयतस् ।
5.8.137.m: Then the pratiprasthātṛ priest sweeps around the southern fire. Both pour the two preliminary libations with the offering ladles.

5.8.137.s: adhvaryur eva pravaraṃ pravṛṇīte prasiddham̐ hotāraṃ vṛṇīte
5.8.137.d: अध्वर्युर् एव प्रवरं प्रवृणीते प्रसिद्धँ होतारं वृणीते
5.8.137.m: The adhvaryu priest alone chooses the ancestral invocation; he chooses the hotṛ priest in the known manner.

5.8.137.s: sīdati hotā prasavam ākāṅkṣataḥ prasūtau sruca ādāyātyākramyāśrāvyāha samidho yaja | iti
5.8.137.d: सीदति होता प्रसवम् आकाङ्क्षतः प्रसूतौ स्रुच आदायात्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह समिधो यज । इति
5.8.137.m: The hotṛ priest sits down. Both await his impulsion. When impelled, having taken the offering ladles, stepped beyond [the altar], and made the call, he says: "Recite for the kindling sticks!"

5.8.137.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhutas | yaja yaja | iti caturthāṣṭamayoḥ samānayamānau |
5.8.137.d: वषट्कृते जुहुतस् । यज यज । इति चतुर्थाष्टमयोः समानयमानौ ।
5.8.137.m: At the vaṣaṭ call they both offer, replenishing [the offering ladle] at the fourth and eighth [offerings] with "Recite, recite!"
At the eighth, the adhvaryu priest pours together all [the ghee].

5.8.138.m: The pratiprasthātṛ priest leaves aside the residue for the after-offerings.

5.8.138.s: nava prayājān iṣṭvodañcāv atyākramya sam̐srāvābhyām ānupūrvam̐ havīm̐ṣy abhighārayatas |
5.8.138.d: नव प्रयाजान् इष्ट्वोदञ्चाव् अत्याक्रम्य सँस्रावाभ्याम् आनुपूर्वँ हवीँष्य् अभिघारयतस् ।
5.8.138.m: Having offered nine fore-offerings, having stepped beyond toward the north, they both baste the oblations in order with the two residues.
The adhvaryu priest bastes [the oblations] beginning with that for Agni in the known manner up to that for Indra-Agni;

5.8.138.s: mārutīṃ pratiprasthātā vāruṇīm adhvaryuḥ kāyaṃ caikakapālam
5.8.138.d: मारुतीं प्रतिप्रस्थाता वारुणीम् अध्वर्युः कायं चैककपालम्
5.8.138.m: the pratiprasthātṛ priest [bastes] the curd-mixture for the Maruts; the adhvaryu priest [bastes] the curd-mixture for Varuṇa and the cake on one potsherd for Ka.

5.8.138.s: athāgnaye somāyety ājyabhāgābhyāṃ caratas | atha pratiprasthātoparamati |
5.8.138.d: अथाग्नये सोमायेत्य् आज्यभागाभ्यां चरतस् । अथ प्रतिप्रस्थातोपरमति ।
5.8.138.m: Then both proceed with the two ghee portions with "To Agni, to Soma!" Then the pratiprasthātṛ priest stops.

5.8.138.s: athādhvaryur ānupūrvam̐ havirbhiś carati prasiddham aindrāgnāt |
5.8.138.d: अथाध्वर्युर् आनुपूर्वँ हविर्भिश् चरति प्रसिद्धम् ऐन्द्राग्नात् ।
5.8.138.m: Then the adhvaryu priest proceeds in order with the oblations in the known manner up to that for Indra-Agni.

5.8.138.s: athādhvaryur uparamati | atha pratiprasthātā mārutyā avadyann āha marudbhyo 'nubrūhi | iti
5.8.138.d: अथाध्वर्युर् उपरमति । अथ प्रतिप्रस्थाता मारुत्या अवद्यन्न् आह मरुद्भ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि । इति
5.8.138.m: Then the adhvaryu priest stops. Then the pratiprasthātṛ priest, cutting a portion from the curd-mixture for the Maruts, says: "Recite for the Maruts!"
With the first portion, he cuts a portion of the flour of śamī leaves and karīra fruits and of the fresh coagulated curds.

5.8.138.s: dvitīyenāvadānena śamīparṇakarīrasaktūn āmikṣāṃ meṣīm ity avadadhāti |
5.8.138.d: द्वितीयेनावदानेन शमीपर्णकरीरसक्तून् आमिक्षां मेषीम् इत्य् अवदधाति ।
5.8.138.m: With the second portion, he puts down the flour of śamī leaves and karīra fruits, the fresh coagulated curds, and the ewe.

5.8.138.s: abhighārayati pratyanakti | atyākramyāśrāvyāha maruto yaja | iti
5.8.138.d: अभिघारयति प्रत्यनक्ति । अत्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह मरुतो यज । इति
5.8.138.m: He bastes it, anoints it, and having stepped beyond and made the call, says: "Recite the offering verse for the Maruts!"

5.8.138.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti | atha pratiprasthātoparamati | athādhvaryur vāruṇyā avadyann āha varuṇāyānubrūhi | iti
5.8.138.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति । अथ प्रतिप्रस्थातोपरमति । अथाध्वर्युर् वारुण्या अवद्यन्न् आह वरुणायानुब्रूहि । इति
5.8.138.m: At the vaṣaṭ call he offers. Then the pratiprasthātṛ priest stops. Then the adhvaryu priest, cutting a portion from the curd-mixture for Varuṇa, says: "Recite for Varuṇa!"
With the first portion, he cuts a portion of the flour of śamī leaves and karīra fruits and of the fresh coagulated curds.

5.8.138.s: dvitīyenāvadānena śamīparṇakarīrasaktūn āmikṣāṃ meṣam ity avadadhāti |
5.8.138.d: द्वितीयेनावदानेन शमीपर्णकरीरसक्तून् आमिक्षां मेषम् इत्य् अवदधाति ।
5.8.138.m: With the second portion, he puts down the flour of śamī leaves and karīra fruits, the fresh coagulated curds, and the ram.

5.8.138.s: abhighārayati pratyanakti | atyākramyāśrāvyāha varuṇaṃ yaja | iti
5.8.138.d: अभिघारयति प्रत्यनक्ति । अत्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह वरुणं यज । इति
5.8.138.m: He bastes it, anoints it, and having stepped beyond and made the call, says: "Recite the offering verse for Varuṇa!"

5.8.138.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti | upām̐śv ekakapālena carati kāyānubrūhi kaṃ yaja | iti |
5.8.138.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति । उपाँश्व् एककपालेन चरति कायानुब्रूहि कं यज । इति ।
5.8.138.m: At the vaṣaṭ call he offers. He proceeds silently with the cake on one potsherd, [saying] "Recite for Ka!" and "Recite the offering verse for Ka!"

5.8.138.s: atha sviṣṭakṛtā caratas | āgneyaprabhṛtīnām evādhvaryur avadyati prasiddham aindrāgnāt |
5.8.138.d: अथ स्विष्टकृता चरतस् । आग्नेयप्रभृतीनाम् एवाध्वर्युर् अवद्यति प्रसिद्धम् ऐन्द्राग्नात् ।
5.8.138.m: Then they both proceed with the sviṣṭakṛt offering. The adhvaryu priest cuts portions from those beginning with that for Agni in the known manner up to that for Indra-Agni;
the pratiprasthātṛ priest from that for the Maruts;

5.8.139.s: vāruṇyā adhvaryur āśayād ekakapālasya ca dvirabhighārayatas | na pratyaṅktas |
5.8.139.d: वारुण्या अध्वर्युर् आशयाद् एककपालस्य च द्विरभिघारयतस् । न प्रत्यङ्क्तस् ।
5.8.139.m: the adhvaryu priest from that for Varuṇa and from the remainder of the cake on one potsherd. They both baste twice; they do not anoint.

5.8.139.s: atyākramyāśrāvyāha | agnim̐ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yaja | iti vaṣaṭkṛta uttarārdhapūrvārdhayor atihāya pūrvā āhutīr juhutas |
5.8.139.d: अत्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह । अग्निँ स्विष्टकृतं यज । इति वषट्कृत उत्तरार्धपूर्वार्धयोर् अतिहाय पूर्वा आहुतीर् जुहुतस् ।
5.8.139.m: Having stepped beyond and made the call, he says: "Recite the offering verse for Agni Sviṣṭakṛt!" At the vaṣaṭ call, passing beyond the earlier offerings, they both offer into the northern half and the eastern half [of their respective fires].
Then they throw these stirring sticks into the two āhavanīya fires.
Then they pour libations over them with the two residues.

5.8.139.s: athodañcāv atyākramya yathāyatanam̐ srucaḥ sādayitvā prāśitram avadāyeḍām avadyatas |
5.8.139.d: अथोदञ्चाव् अत्याक्रम्य यथायतनँ स्रुचः सादयित्वा प्राशित्रम् अवदायेडाम् अवद्यतस् ।
5.8.139.m: Then, having stepped beyond toward the north, having placed the offering ladles in their proper places, and having cut off the prāśitra portion, they both cut off the iḍā portion.
The adhvaryu priest cuts portions from those beginning with that for Agni in the known manner up to that for Indra-Agni;

5.8.139.s: mārutyai pratiprasthātā vāruṇyā adhvaryur āśayād ekakapālasya ca |
5.8.139.d: मारुत्यै प्रतिप्रस्थाता वारुण्या अध्वर्युर् आशयाद् एककपालस्य च ।
5.8.139.m: the pratiprasthātṛ priest from that for the Maruts; the adhvaryu priest from that for Varuṇa and from the remainder of the cake on one potsherd.
He bastes it. Then the pratiprasthātṛ priest approaches the northern altar.

5.9.139.s: upahūtāyām iḍāyām agnīdha ādadhāti ṣaḍavattam | prāśnanti
5.9.139.d: उपहूतायाम् इडायाम् अग्नीध आदधाति षडवत्तम् । प्राश्नन्ति
5.9.139.m: When the iḍā has been invoked, he places the six-cut portion for the Agnīdh. They partake of it.

5.9.139.s: mārjayante | athāha brahmaṇe prāśitraṃ parihara | iti pari prāśitram̐ haranti |
5.9.139.d: मार्जयन्ते । अथाह ब्रह्मणे प्राशित्रं परिहर । इति परि प्राशित्रँ हरन्ति ।
5.9.139.m: They cleanse themselves. Then he says: "Carry the prāśitra around to the Brahman!" They carry the prāśitra around.

5.9.139.s: anv apo 'nu vedena brahmabhāgam athānvāhāryaṃ yācati tasmin yathāśraddhaṃ dadāti |
5.9.139.d: अन्व् अपो ऽनु वेदेन ब्रह्मभागम् अथान्वाहार्यं याचति तस्मिन् यथाश्रद्धं ददाति ।
5.9.139.m: Water follows, and the Brahman's share follows along with the broom. Then he asks for the anvāhārya cooked rice; on it [the sacrificer] gives according to his faith.

5.9.139.s: udvāsayanty etad dhavir ucchiṣṭam āsādayanti vājine
5.9.139.d: उद्वासयन्त्य् एतद् धविर् उच्छिष्टम् आसादयन्ति वाजिने
5.9.139.m: They remove this remnant of the oblation. They place the two [vessels] for the whey.

5.9.139.s: adhvaryur eva saṃpraiṣam āha brahman prasthāsyāmaḥ samidham ādhāyāgnīd agnīn sakṛtsakṛt saṃmṛḍḍhi | iti |
5.9.139.d: अध्वर्युर् एव संप्रैषम् आह ब्रह्मन् प्रस्थास्यामः समिधम् आधायाग्नीद् अग्नीन् सकृत्सकृत् संमृड्ढि । इति ।
5.9.139.m: The adhvaryu priest alone gives the direction: "O Brahman, we shall set forth! O Agnīdh, having put on a kindling stick, sweep around the fires once each!"

5.9.139.s: athādhvaryuḥ pṛṣadājyaṃ vihatya juhvām̐ samānīyātyākramyāśrāvyāha devān yaja | iti
5.9.139.d: अथाध्वर्युः पृषदाज्यं विहत्य जुह्वाँ समानीयात्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह देवान् यज । इति
5.9.139.m: Then the adhvaryu priest, having stirred the speckled butter and poured it together into the offering spoon, having stepped beyond and made the call, says: "Recite the offering verse for the gods!"

5.9.140.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhutas | yaja yaja | iti navānūyājān iṣṭvodañcāv atyākramya yathāyatanam̐ srucaḥ sādayitvā vājavatībhyām̐ sruco vyūhataḥ
5.9.140.d: वषट्कृते जुहुतस् । यज यज । इति नवानूयाजान् इष्ट्वोदञ्चाव् अत्याक्रम्य यथायतनँ स्रुचः सादयित्वा वाजवतीभ्याँ स्रुचो व्यूहतः
5.9.140.m: When the vaṣaṭ call has been made, both offer. Having offered the nine after-offerings with "Sacrifice, sacrifice," having stepped over towards the north, and having placed the ladles according to their proper places, they displace the ladles with the two [verses] containing [the word] 'vājin'.

5.9.140.s: śaṃyunā prastaraparidhi saṃprakīrya saṃprasrāvya sruco vimucya
5.9.140.d: शंयुना प्रस्तरपरिधि संप्रकीर्य संप्रस्राव्य स्रुचो विमुच्य
5.9.140.m: Having scattered the grass bundle and the enclosing sticks with the Śaṃyu [formula], having poured together [the rinsings], and having unyoked the ladles,

5.9.140.s: tathaiva kam̐sau vā camasau vānājyaliptau yācataḥ
5.9.140.d: तथैव कँसौ वा चमसौ वानाज्यलिप्तौ याचतः
5.9.140.m: just so they ask for two bronze vessels or two cups, not smeared with ghee.

5.9.140.s: samānī vājinayoś caryā | adhvaryur eva pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyaṅṅ ādrutya patnīḥ saṃyājya prāṅ etya dhruvām āpyāyya trīṇi pāśubandhikāni samiṣṭayajūm̐ṣi juhoti |
5.9.140.d: समानी वाजिनयोश् चर्या । अध्वर्युर् एव प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आद्रुत्य पत्नीः संयाज्य प्राङ् एत्य ध्रुवाम् आप्याय्य त्रीणि पाशुबन्धिकानि समिष्टयजूँषि जुहोति ।
5.9.140.m: The performance for the two vājina-offerings is identical. The adhvaryu priest alone, having turned clockwise, having run westward, and having made offerings to the wives [of the gods], goes eastward, replenishes the dhruvā ladle, and offers the three samiṣṭayajus formulas pertaining to the animal sacrifice.
The pratiprasthātṛ priest [offers] the one pertaining to the new- and full-moon sacrifices on the southern [fire].

5.9.140.s: atha pūrṇapātraviṣṇukramaiś caritvā na visṛjate vratam
5.9.140.d: अथ पूर्णपात्रविष्णुक्रमैश् चरित्वा न विसृजते व्रतम्
5.9.140.m: Then, having performed [the rites] with the full-cup and the Viṣṇu-strides, he does not release the vow.

5.9.140.s: atha yācaty ājyasthālīm̐ sasruvām̐ srucaṃ barhiḥ prativasanīye vāsasī vāruṇyai niṣkāsaṃ tuṣān iti |
5.9.140.d: अथ याचत्य् आज्यस्थालीँ सस्रुवाँ स्रुचं बर्हिः प्रतिवसनीये वाससी वारुण्यै निष्कासं तुषान् इति ।
5.9.140.m: Then he asks for: the ghee-pot with the sruva spoon, the ladle, the sacrificial grass, two sets of replacement clothes, the scraped-off residue for Varuṇa, and the chaff.
Having taken these, he says, "Come, sacrificer."

5.9.140.s: anvag yajamāno 'nūcī patny antareṇa cātvālotkarāv udaṅṅ upaniṣkramya yatrāpastadyanti
5.9.140.d: अन्वग् यजमानो ऽनूची पत्न्य् अन्तरेण चात्वालोत्कराव् उदङ्ङ् उपनिष्क्रम्य यत्रापस्तद्यन्ति
5.9.140.m: Behind [him comes] the sacrificer, following [him] the wife; having gone out northward between the pit and the rubbish-heap, [they go] to where waters flow.

5.9.140.s: sāma caiva nāha devīr āpa eṣa vo garbhas | iti ca | athāpratīkṣam āyanti varuṇasyāntarhityai
5.9.140.d: साम चैव नाह देवीर् आप एष वो गर्भस् । इति च । अथाप्रतीक्षम् आयन्ति वरुणस्यान्तर्हित्यै
5.9.140.m: And he does not chant a sāman, nor [does he recite] "O divine waters, this is your embryo...". Then they return without looking back, for the concealment of Varuṇa.

5.9.140.s: prapathe samidhaḥ kurvate | edho 'sy edhiṣīmahi | iti |
5.9.140.d: प्रपथे समिधः कुर्वते । एधो ऽस्य् एधिषीमहि । इति ।
5.9.140.m: On the way, they make kindling sticks with "You are fuel; may we prosper."

5.9.140.s: etyāhavanīye 'bhyādadhāti samid asi tejo 'si tejo mayi dhehi | iti |
5.9.140.d: एत्याहवनीये ऽभ्यादधाति समिद् असि तेजो ऽसि तेजो मयि धेहि । इति ।
5.9.140.m: Having arrived, he places [a stick] on the āhavanīya fire with "You are kindling; you are splendor; place splendor in me."

5.9.140.s: athāhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante | apo anv acāriṣam̐ rasena samasṛkṣmahi | payasvām̐ agna āgamaṃ taṃ mā saṃsṛja varcasa | iti |
5.9.140.d: अथाहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठन्ते । अपो अन्व् अचारिषँ रसेन समसृक्ष्महि । पयस्वाँ अग्न आगमं तं मा संसृज वर्चस । इति ।
5.9.140.m: Then they worship the āhavanīya fire with "I have pursued the waters; we have united with the sap; rich in milk, O Agni, I have come; unite me with luster."

5.9.141.s: atha paurṇamāsavaimṛdhābhyām iṣṭvā yajamānāyatana upaviśya treṇyā śalalyā lohitāyasasya ca kṣureṇa śīrṣan ni ca vartayate pari ca vapate yad gharmaḥ paryavartayat | antān pṛthivyā divaḥ | agnir īśāna ojasā varuṇo dhītibhiḥ saha | indro marudbhiḥ sakhibhiḥ saha || agnis tigmena śociṣā tapa ākrāntam uṣṇihā | śiras tapasy āhitam | vaiśvānarasya tejasā | ṛtenāsya nivartaye satyena parivartaye | tapasāsyānuvartaye śivenāsyopavartaye śagmenāsyābhivartaye || śīrṣṇas tad ṛtam | tat satyam | tad vratam | tac chakeyam | tena śakeyam | tena rādhyāsam iti purastād evāgre 'tha dakṣiṇato 'tha paścād athottarato 'thopariṣṭāt
5.9.141.d: अथ पौर्णमासवैमृधाभ्याम् इष्ट्वा यजमानायतन उपविश्य त्रेण्या शलल्या लोहितायसस्य च क्षुरेण शीर्षन् नि च वर्तयते परि च वपते यद् घर्मः पर्यवर्तयत् । अन्तान् पृथिव्या दिवः । अग्निर् ईशान ओजसा वरुणो धीतिभिः सह । इन्द्रो मरुद्भिः सखिभिः सह ॥ अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा तप आक्रान्तम् उष्णिहा । शिरस् तपस्य् आहितम् । वैश्वानरस्य तेजसा । ऋतेनास्य निवर्तये सत्येन परिवर्तये । तपसास्यानुवर्तये शिवेनास्योपवर्तये शग्मेनास्याभिवर्तये ॥ शीर्ष्णस् तद् ऋतम् । तत् सत्यम् । तद् व्रतम् । तच् छकेयम् । तेन शकेयम् । तेन राध्यासम् इति पुरस्ताद् एवाग्रे ऽथ दक्षिणतो ऽथ पश्चाद् अथोत्तरतो ऽथोपरिष्टात्
5.9.141.m: Then, having sacrificed with the full-moon and Vaimṛdha [offerings], and having sat down in the seat of the sacrificer, he shaves and trims [the hair] on his head with a porcupine quill with three white spots and a razor of red copper, [with the verses]: "When the Gharma turned around / the ends of earth and heaven; / Agni ruling with vigor, / Varuṇa with thoughts, / Indra with his Marut comrades; // Agni with sharp brilliance, / heat has surpassed the uṣṇih; / the head is placed in heat / with the luster of Vaiśvānara; / with truth I shave this; / with truth I trim this; / with heat I follow this; / with auspiciousness I bring this near; / with comfort I bring this forth" from the head; [saying] "that is cosmic order," "that is truth," "that is the vow," "may I be capable of that," "may I be capable through that," "may I succeed through that"—first in the front, then on the right, then behind, then on the left, then on top.

5.9.141.s: saṃtiṣṭhante varuṇapraghāsahavīm̐ṣi parivatsarīṇām̐ svastim āśāste | ity āśāste ||
5.9.141.d: संतिष्ठन्ते वरुणप्रघासहवीँषि परिवत्सरीणाँ स्वस्तिम् आशास्ते । इत्य् आशास्ते ॥
5.9.141.m: The oblations of the Varuṇapraghāsa festival come to an end. He prays: "He prays for well-being for a year."

5.10.141.s: athātaś caturṣu māseṣu sākamedhahavirbhir yakṣyamāṇo bhavati sa upakalpayate treṇīm̐ śalalīṃ lohitāyasasya ca kṣuraṃ catuṣṭayāni puroḍāśakapālāni catasraś carusthālīs tāvanti mekṣaṇāni pṛṣadājyāya dadhi |
5.10.141.d: अथातश् चतुर्षु मासेषु साकमेधहविर्भिर् यक्ष्यमाणो भवति स उपकल्पयते त्रेणीँ शललीं लोहितायसस्य च क्षुरं चतुष्टयानि पुरोडाशकपालानि चतस्रश् चरुस्थालीस् तावन्ति मेक्षणानि पृषदाज्याय दधि ।
5.10.141.m: Then, four months later, he is about to sacrifice with the Sākamedha oblations. He procures: a porcupine quill with three white spots, a razor of red copper, four sets of potsherds for the sacrificial cakes, four pots for the caru porridge, as many stirring sticks, [and] curds for the clotted ghee.

5.10.141.s: atha paurṇamāsyā upavasathe 'gnaye 'nīkavate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati sākam̐ sūryeṇodayatā
5.10.141.d: अथ पौर्णमास्या उपवसथे ऽग्नये ऽनीकवते पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति साकँ सूर्येणोदयता
5.10.141.m: Then, on the fast-day of the full moon, as the sun rises together [with the dawn], he pours out an eight-potsherd cake for Agni Anīkavat.
That well-known sacrifice comes to an end.

5.10.141.s: atha madhyaṃdine marudbhyaḥ sāṃtapanebhyaś caruṃ nirvapati sā prasiddheṣṭiḥ saṃtiṣṭhate |
5.10.141.d: अथ मध्यंदिने मरुद्भ्यः सांतपनेभ्यश् चरुं निर्वपति सा प्रसिद्धेष्टिः संतिष्ठते ।
5.10.141.m: Then at midday he pours out a caru porridge for the Sāṃtapana Maruts. That well-known sacrifice comes to an end.

5.10.141.s: athāsyaitad ahar marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyo vatsā apākṛtā bhavanti |
5.10.141.d: अथास्यैतद् अहर् मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधिभ्यो वत्सा अपाकृता भवन्ति ।
5.10.141.m: Then on this day the calves are separated for the Gṛhamedhin Maruts.

5.10.141.s: atha sāyam̐ hute 'gnihotre sarvāsāṃ dugdhe gārhapatye gṛhamedhīyaṃ carum̐ śrapayitvābhighāryodañcam udvāsayati |
5.10.141.d: अथ सायँ हुते ऽग्निहोत्रे सर्वासां दुग्धे गार्हपत्ये गृहमेधीयं चरुँ श्रपयित्वाभिघार्योदञ्चम् उद्वासयति ।
5.10.141.m: Then, when the evening agnihotra has been offered, in the milk of all [the cows], having cooked the Gṛhamedhīya caru porridge on the gārhapatya fire and having basted it, he takes it off toward the north.

5.10.141.s: athaitāṃ pātrīṃ nirṇijyopastīrya tasyām enam asaṃghnann ivoddharati
5.10.141.d: अथैतां पात्रीं निर्णिज्योपस्तीर्य तस्याम् एनम् असंघ्नन्न् इवोद्धरति
5.10.141.m: Then, having cleansed this dish and having spread under [a layer of ghee], he takes it out into it as if without crushing it.

5.10.141.s: sarpir āsecanaṃ kṛtvā prabhūtam ājyam ānīyāntarvedy āsādayati |
5.10.141.d: सर्पिर् आसेचनं कृत्वा प्रभूतम् आज्यम् आनीयान्तर्वेद्य् आसादयति ।
5.10.141.m: Having made a channel for the clarified butter and having poured plentiful ghee, he places it within the altar.
Then he proceeds with the two ghee-portions, for Agni and for Soma.

5.10.142.s: athopastīrya pūrvārdhāc caror avadyann āha marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyo 'nubrūhi | iti
5.10.142.d: अथोपस्तीर्य पूर्वार्धाच् चरोर् अवद्यन्न् आह मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधिभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि । इति
5.10.142.m: Then, having spread under [a layer of ghee] and cutting portions from the eastern half of the caru, he says: "Recite for the Gṛhamedhin Maruts."
Having cut a portion from the eastern half, he cuts from the western half. He bastes [it]. He anoints back [the source].

5.10.142.s: atyākramyāśrāvyāha maruto gṛhamedhino yaja | iti vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti |
5.10.142.d: अत्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह मरुतो गृहमेधिनो यज । इति वषट्कृते जुहोति ।
5.10.142.m: Having stepped across and made the call, he says: "Sacrifice to the Gṛhamedhin Maruts." When the vaṣaṭ call has been made, he offers.

5.10.142.s: atha sviṣṭakṛtā carati | iḍānto gṛhamedhīyaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate
5.10.142.d: अथ स्विष्टकृता चरति । इडान्तो गृहमेधीयः संतिष्ठते
5.10.142.m: Then he proceeds with the sviṣṭakṛt offering. The Gṛhamedhīya sacrifice ends with the iḍā.

5.10.142.s: pūrṇadarvyāya kṣāmakāṣaṃ pariśinaṣṭi prativeśam̐ strīkumārebhyaḥ pacanti |
5.10.142.d: पूर्णदर्व्याय क्षामकाषं परिशिनष्टि प्रतिवेशँ स्त्रीकुमारेभ्यः पचन्ति ।
5.10.142.m: He leaves behind the burnt crust for the full-ladle offering. They cook around for the women and children in every household.

5.10.142.s: āśitā bhavanti | āñjate | abhyañjate | anu vatsān vāsayanti
5.10.142.d: आशिता भवन्ति । आञ्जते । अभ्यञ्जते । अनु वत्सान् वासयन्ति
5.10.142.m: They are fed; they anoint their eyes; they anoint their bodies; they let the calves stay [with the cows].

5.10.142.s: savātyor evaitām̐ rātriṃ vatsaṃ badhnanti | athādhvaryur apararātra ādrutya nityavatsāyai payasāgnihotraṃ juhoti |
5.10.142.d: सवात्योर् एवैताँ रात्रिं वत्सं बध्नन्ति । अथाध्वर्युर् अपररात्र आद्रुत्य नित्यवत्सायै पयसाग्निहोत्रं जुहोति ।
5.10.142.m: They tie the calf for this night between two posts. Then the adhvaryu priest, having run up in the latter part of the night, offers the agnihotra with the milk of a cow whose calf is regular.

5.10.142.s: athaitāṃ darvīṃ nirṇijyopastīrya tasyām etam̐ sarvaśa eva kṣāmakāṣam avadadhāti
5.10.142.d: अथैतां दर्वीं निर्णिज्योपस्तीर्य तस्याम् एतँ सर्वश एव क्षामकाषम् अवदधाति
5.10.142.m: Then, having washed this ladle and having spread under [a layer of ghee], he places all of this burnt crust into it.

5.10.142.s: dvir abhighārayati | atha puro'nuvākyām anvāha pūrṇā darvi parāpata supūrṇā punar āpata | vasneva vikrīṇāvahā iṣam ūrjam̐ śatakrato iti
5.10.142.d: द्विर् अभिघारयति । अथ पुरोऽनुवाक्याम् अन्वाह पूर्णा दर्वि परापत सुपूर्णा पुनर् आपत । वस्नेव विक्रीणावहा इषम् ऊर्जँ शतक्रतो इति
5.10.142.m: He bastes it twice. Then he recites the puronuvākyā verse: "Fly away, O full ladle; fly back, O well-filled one; like two traders, may we exchange food and strength, O Śatakratu!"

5.10.142.s: yajati dehi me dadāmi te ni me dhehi ni te dadhe | nihāram in ni me harā nihāraṃ niharāmi te svāhā | iti |
5.10.142.d: यजति देहि मे ददामि ते नि मे धेहि नि ते दधे । निहारम् इन् नि मे हरा निहारं निहरामि ते स्वाहा । इति ।
5.10.142.m: He sacrifices: "Give to me, I give to you; bestow on me, I bestow on you; bring to me a gift, I bring a gift to you, svāhā!"

5.10.142.s: ṛṣabha ehi | ity ṛṣabhasya ravathe juhuyāt |
5.10.142.d: ऋषभ एहि । इत्य् ऋषभस्य रवथे जुहुयात् ।
5.10.142.m: With "Come, O bull," he should offer at the roar of a bull.

5.10.142.s: brahmaṇo hiṃkāra ity etad aparam | gārhapatye juhoty anvārabdhe yajamāne svāhā | iti |
5.10.142.d: ब्रह्मणो हिंकार इत्य् एतद् अपरम् । गार्हपत्ये जुहोत्य् अन्वारब्धे यजमाने स्वाहा । इति ।
5.10.142.m: The hiṃkāra of the brahman priest is another [option]. He offers on the gārhapatya fire with "svāhā!" while the sacrificer holds onto him from behind.

5.10.142.s: atha pṛṣṭhyām̐ stīrtvāpaḥ praṇīya marudbhyaḥ krīḍibhyaḥ puroḍāśam̐ saptakapālaṃ nirvapati sākam̐ suryeṇodyatā
5.10.142.d: अथ पृष्ठ्याँ स्तीर्त्वापः प्रणीय मरुद्भ्यः क्रीडिभ्यः पुरोडाशँ सप्तकपालं निर्वपति साकँ सुर्येणोद्यता
5.10.142.m: Then, having strewn along the backbone line and having brought forward the waters, he pours out a seven-potsherd cake for the Krīḍin Maruts as the sun rises together [with the dawn].
That well-known sacrifice comes to an end.

5.10.142.s: atha tadānīm eva pṛṣṭhyām̐ stīrtvāpaḥ praṇīya nirvapati | āgneyam aṣṭākapālam iti pañca saṃcarāṇi | aindrāgnam ekādaśakapālam aindraṃ caruṃ vaiśvakarmaṇam ekakapālam iti
5.10.142.d: अथ तदानीम् एव पृष्ठ्याँ स्तीर्त्वापः प्रणीय निर्वपति । आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालम् इति पञ्च संचराणि । ऐन्द्राग्नम् एकादशकपालम् ऐन्द्रं चरुं वैश्वकर्मणम् एककपालम् इति
5.10.142.m: Then, at that very time, having strewn along the backbone line and having brought forward the waters, he pours out the five common offerings: "an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni," "an eleven-potsherd [cake] for Indra and Agni, a caru porridge for Indra, and a one-potsherd [cake] for Viśvakarman."

5.10.143.s: tvacaṃ puroḍāśānāṃ grāhayitvā śrapayitvābhivāsya prāṅ etyāpyebhyo ninīya stambayajur harati |
5.10.143.d: त्वचं पुरोडाशानां ग्राहयित्वा श्रपयित्वाभिवास्य प्राङ् एत्याप्येभ्यो निनीय स्तम्बयजुर् हरति ।
5.10.143.m: Having made the sacrificial cakes form a crust, baked them, covered them, gone eastward, and poured out [water] for the Apyas, he carries the grass-clod oblation.

5.10.143.s: idam eva prasiddhaṃ pauroḍāśikam | trir yajuṣā tūṣṇīṃ caturtham | pūrvaṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti
5.10.143.d: इदम् एव प्रसिद्धं पौरोडाशिकम् । त्रिर् यजुषा तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् । पूर्वं परिग्राहं परिगृह्णाति
5.10.143.m: This is the well-known procedure of the cake-offering. Thrice with a formula, the fourth time silently, he marks out the first boundary.

5.10.143.s: karaṇaṃ japati | uddhanti | uddhatād āgnīdhras trir harati
5.10.143.d: करणं जपति । उद्धन्ति । उद्धताद् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिर् हरति
5.10.143.m: He mutters the ritual tool formula. He digs up. The āgnīdhra priest carries [the earth] thrice from what has been dug up.

5.10.143.s: yad āgnīdhras trir haraty atha cātvālasyāvṛtā cātvālaṃ parilikhati | uttaraveder āvṛtottaravediṃ nivapati |
5.10.143.d: यद् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिर् हरत्य् अथ चात्वालस्यावृता चात्वालं परिलिखति । उत्तरवेदेर् आवृतोत्तरवेदिं निवपति ।
5.10.143.m: When the āgnīdhra has carried [earth] thrice, then according to the procedure of the pit, he marks around the pit. According to the procedure of the high altar, he heaps up the high altar.
Having fashioned the upper navel, he leads forward the fire according to the procedure of the fire.

5.10.143.s: agnivaty uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhya yoyupitvā tiryañcam̐ sphyam̐ stabdhvā saṃpraiṣam āha prokṣaṇīr āsādaya | idhmābarhir upasādaya sruvaṃ ca srucaś ca saṃmṛḍḍhi tūṣṇīṃ pṛṣadājyagrahaṇīm | patnīm̐ saṃnahya | ājyena ca dadhnā codehi | iti |
5.10.143.d: अग्निवत्य् उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्य योयुपित्वा तिर्यञ्चँ स्फ्यँ स्तब्ध्वा संप्रैषम् आह प्रोक्षणीर् आसादय । इध्माबर्हिर् उपसादय स्रुवं च स्रुचश् च संमृड्ढि तूष्णीं पृषदाज्यग्रहणीम् । पत्नीँ संनह्य । आज्येन च दध्ना चोदेहि । इति ।
5.10.143.m: Having marked the northern boundary-line [of the altar] when the fire has been brought, having smoothed [the altar], and having fixed the wooden sword crosswise, he utters the direction: "Set down the sprinkling water; place near the kindling wood and the sacrificial grass; cleanse the dipping spoon and the offering ladles, [and] silently the ladle for the spotted ghee; gird the [sacrificer's] wife; and come forward with the clarified butter and the curd."

5.10.143.s: āhṛtāsu prokṣāṇīṣūdasya sphyaṃ mārjayitvedhmābarhir upasādya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyaṅṅ ādrutya sruvaṃ ca srucaś ca saṃmārṣṭi tūṣṇīṃ pṛṣadājyagrahaṇīm |
5.10.143.d: आहृतासु प्रोक्षाणीषूदस्य स्फ्यं मार्जयित्वेध्माबर्हिर् उपसाद्य प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आद्रुत्य स्रुवं च स्रुचश् च संमार्ष्टि तूष्णीं पृषदाज्यग्रहणीम् ।
5.10.143.m: When the sprinkling waters have been brought, having set aside the wooden sword, having cleansed [himself], having placed near the kindling wood and the sacrificial grass, having turned around clockwise, and having run westward, he cleanses the dipping spoon and the offering ladles, [and] silently the ladle for the spotted ghee.

5.10.143.s: patnīm̐ saṃnahyājyena ca dadhnā codety ājyaṃ ca prokṣaṇīś cotpūya prasiddham |
5.10.143.d: पत्नीँ संनह्याज्येन च दध्ना चोदेत्य् आज्यं च प्रोक्षणीश् चोत्पूय प्रसिद्धम् ।
5.10.143.m: Having girded the wife and having come forward with the clarified butter and the curd, having purified the clarified butter and the sprinkling waters, [the ritual proceeds] in the established manner.

5.10.143.d: यथा वैश्वदेवहवीँष्य् एवँ संतिष्ठते ऽन्यत्र वाजिनात् ।
5.10.143.m: In the manner of the Vaiśvadeva oblations, so it is completed, except for the vājina oblation.

5.10.143.s: atha pūrṇapātraviṣṇukramaiś caritvā na visṛjate vratam ||
5.10.143.d: अथ पूर्णपात्रविष्णुक्रमैश् चरित्वा न विसृजते व्रतम् ॥
5.10.143.m: Then, having performed [the rites] with the full-vessel-water and the steps of Viṣṇu, he does not release the vow.

5.11.143.s: mahāpitṛyajñaṃ kariṣyann upakalpayate vrīhīm̐ś ca yavām̐ś ca ṣaṭkapālāny abhivānyāyai dugdham ardhapātraṃ dve nave pātre ikṣuśalākāṃ trīn parṇasevān samūlam barhir varṣīyām̐sam idhmam idhmāt pariśrayaṇaṃ kaśipūpabarhaṇe āñjanābhyañjane daśām̐ sphyam udakumbhau yajñāyudhānīti |
5.11.143.d: महापितृयज्ञं करिष्यन्न् उपकल्पयते व्रीहीँश् च यवाँश् च षट्कपालान्य् अभिवान्यायै दुग्धम् अर्धपात्रं द्वे नवे पात्रे इक्षुशलाकां त्रीन् पर्णसेवान् समूलम् बर्हिर् वर्षीयाँसम् इध्मम् इध्मात् परिश्रयणं कशिपूपबर्हणे आञ्जनाभ्यञ्जने दशाँ स्फ्यम् उदकुम्भौ यज्ञायुधानीति ।
5.11.143.m: Intending to perform the Mahāpitṛyajña, he prepares: rice grains and barley grains, six potsherds, milk from a cow whose calf is of the same age [as itself], half a cupful [thereof], two new vessels, a reed of sugar-cane, three leafy plates, sacrificial grass with roots, a taller kindling wood, an enclosure [made] of kindling wood, a mat and a pillow, collyrium and ointment, a woolen fringe, a wooden sword, two water-jars, and the sacrificial utensils.
Then he strews around the gārhapatya fire.

5.11.144.s: tam uttareṇaikaikam̐ sam̐sādayati kaśipūpabarhaṇe āñjanābhyañjane daśām̐ sphyam udakumbhau yajñāyudhānīti |
5.11.144.d: तम् उत्तरेणैकैकँ सँसादयति कशिपूपबर्हणे आञ्जनाभ्यञ्जने दशाँ स्फ्यम् उदकुम्भौ यज्ञायुधानीति ।
5.11.144.m: To the north of it, he sets down one by one the mat and the pillow, the collyrium and ointment, the woolen fringe, the wooden sword, the two water-jars, and the sacrificial utensils.

5.11.144.s: atha yajñopavītaṃ kṛtvottareṇa gārhapatyam upaviśya pavitravatyāgnihotrahavaṇyā nirvapati
5.11.144.d: अथ यज्ञोपवीतं कृत्वोत्तरेण गार्हपत्यम् उपविश्य पवित्रवत्याग्निहोत्रहवण्या निर्वपति
5.11.144.m: Then, having worn the sacred thread over the left shoulder [yajñopavīta], and having sat down to the north of the gārhapatya fire, he portions out [the grains] with the agnihotra-offering ladle holding purifiers:

5.11.144.s: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śviṇor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām̐ somāya pitṛmate juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi | iti caturo muṣṭīn vrīhīṇāṃ nirvapati |
5.11.144.d: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विणोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याँ सोमाय पितृमते जुष्टं निर्वपामि । इति चतुरो मुष्टीन् व्रीहीणां निर्वपति ।
5.11.144.m: "At the impulse of the god Savitar, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I portion thee out agreeable to Soma accompanied by the Pitṛs"—with these words he portions out four handfuls of rice grains.

5.11.144.s: etām eva pratipadaṃ kṛtvā pitṛbhyo barhiṣadbhyo juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi | iti caturo yavānām
5.11.144.d: एताम् एव प्रतिपदं कृत्वा पितृभ्यो बर्हिषद्भ्यो जुष्टं निर्वपामि । इति चतुरो यवानाम्
5.11.144.m: Making the very same opening formula, he portions out four [handfuls] of barley grains with: "...agreeable to the Pitṛs seated on the sacrificial grass I portion thee out."

5.11.144.s: etām eva pratipadaṃ kṛtvā pitṛbhyo 'gniṣvāttebhyo juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi | iti catura eva yavānām |
5.11.144.d: एताम् एव प्रतिपदं कृत्वा पितृभ्यो ऽग्निष्वात्तेभ्यो जुष्टं निर्वपामि । इति चतुर एव यवानाम् ।
5.11.144.m: Making the very same opening formula, he portions out four [handfuls] of barley grains with: "...agreeable to the Pitṛs consumed by fire I portion thee out."
Of these, he summons the maker of the oblation over the rice grains only.
They raise up the barley grains; he releases his speech with [the call to] the oblation-maker.

5.11.144.s: samānaṃ karmādhivapanāt | adhyupya dakṣiṇārdhe gārhapatyasya ṣaṭkapālāny upadadhāti |
5.11.144.d: समानं कर्माधिवपनात् । अध्युप्य दक्षिणार्धे गार्हपत्यस्य षट्कपालान्य् उपदधाति ।
5.11.144.m: The ritual is the same up to the pouring of the grains; having poured them, he sets down six potsherds on the southern half of the gārhapatya fire.

5.11.144.s: athaitān yavān ulūkhale parikṣudya gārhapatya ekakapālam adhiśritya bharjayanti
5.11.144.d: अथैतान् यवान् उलूखले परिक्षुद्य गार्हपत्य एककपालम् अधिश्रित्य भर्जयन्ति
5.11.144.m: Then, having crushed these barley grains in a mortar and having placed a single potsherd on the gārhapatya fire, they roast them.

5.11.144.s: bahurūpā dhānāḥ kṛtvā teṣām ardhā dhānā bhavanti |
5.11.144.d: बहुरूपा धानाः कृत्वा तेषाम् अर्धा धाना भवन्ति ।
5.11.144.m: Having made diverse roasted grains, half of them become parched grains.

5.11.144.s: athetarān saktūn kurvanti kṛtāni piṣṭāni samupya saṃyutyādhipṛṇakti puroḍāśam̐ ṣaṭkapālam
5.11.144.d: अथेतरान् सक्तून् कुर्वन्ति कृतानि पिष्टानि समुप्य संयुत्याधिपृणक्ति पुरोडाशँ षट्कपालम्
5.11.144.m: Then they make the other [half into] groats; having heaped together the prepared flour and mixed it with water, he puts on the fire a cake on six potsherds.

5.11.144.s: athottarato bhasmamiśrān aṅgārān nirūhya teṣu navaṃ pātram adhiśritya tiraḥ pavitram ājyam ānīya tiraḥ pavitraṃ dhānā āvapati |
5.11.144.d: अथोत्तरतो भस्ममिश्रान् अङ्गारान् निरूह्य तेषु नवं पात्रम् अधिश्रित्य तिरः पवित्रम् आज्यम् आनीय तिरः पवित्रं धाना आवपति ।
5.11.144.m: Then, having pushed aside to the north the burning embers mixed with ash, having placed a new vessel upon them, and having poured clarified butter across a purifier, he casts the parched grains across the purifier.
Then he asks for this milk of the cow with a like calf, half a cupful.
Into it, having thrown the groats across a purifier, he stirs it with a single sugar-cane reed.

5.11.144.s: dakṣiṇopamanthati | anārabhyopamanthati | iti brāhmaṇam athottarato bhasmamiśrān aṅgārān nirūhya teṣv adhiśrayati
5.11.144.d: दक्षिणोपमन्थति । अनारभ्योपमन्थति । इति ब्राह्मणम् अथोत्तरतो भस्ममिश्रान् अङ्गारान् निरूह्य तेष्व् अधिश्रयति
5.11.144.m: He stirs it from left to right [towards the south]; "He stirs it without holding it," says the brāhmaṇa passage; then, having pushed aside to the north the burning embers mixed with ash, he places it upon them.
Having caused the crust of the cake to form and having covered it with embers, right there he pours out [water] for the Āpyas.

5.11.145.s: dakṣiṇata eṣa sama sthaṇḍilaḥ kṛto bhavati
5.11.145.d: दक्षिणत एष सम स्थण्डिलः कृतो भवति
5.11.145.m: To the south this level mound has been made.

5.11.145.s: tad etāṃ caturaśrāṃ vedim ālikhaty eva na khanati
5.11.145.d: तद् एतां चतुरश्रां वेदिम् आलिखत्य् एव न खनति
5.11.145.m: He merely marks out this square altar; he does not dig it.

5.11.145.d: तस्यै मध्यतो ऽन्वाहार्यपचनम् उपसमाधाय स्तम्बयजुर् हरति ॥
5.11.145.m: Having added fuel to the anvāhāryapacana fire in the middle of it, he carries away the bundle of grass together with the formula.

5.12.145.s: idam eva prasiddhaṃ pauroḍāśikam | trir yajuṣā tūṣṇīṃ caturtham |
5.12.145.d: इदम् एव प्रसिद्धं पौरोडाशिकम् । त्रिर् यजुषा तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् ।
5.12.145.m: This very procedure of the cake-offering is well known: three times with the formula, silently the fourth.

5.12.145.s: pūrvaṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti karaṇaṃ japaty uddhanti | uddhatād āgnīdhras trir harati
5.12.145.d: पूर्वं परिग्राहं परिगृह्णाति करणं जपत्य् उद्धन्ति । उद्धताद् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिर् हरति
5.12.145.m: He marks the first boundary-line; he mutters the karaṇa formula and digs up [the ground]; from what is dug up, the āgnīdhra priest carries away [earth] thrice.

5.12.145.s: yad āgnīdhras trir haraty athottaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhya yoyupitvā tiryañcam̐ sphyam̐ stabdhvā saṃpraiṣam āha prokṣaṇīr āsādaya | idhmābarhir upasādaya sruvaṃ ca srucaś ca saṃmṛḍḍhi | ājyenodehi | iti |
5.12.145.d: यद् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिर् हरत्य् अथोत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्य योयुपित्वा तिर्यञ्चँ स्फ्यँ स्तब्ध्वा संप्रैषम् आह प्रोक्षणीर् आसादय । इध्माबर्हिर् उपसादय स्रुवं च स्रुचश् च संमृड्ढि । आज्येनोदेहि । इति ।
5.12.145.m: When the āgnīdhra priest has carried it away thrice, having marked the northern boundary-line, having smoothed [the altar], and having fixed the wooden sword crosswise, he utters the direction: "Set down the sprinkling water; place near the kindling wood and the sacrificial grass; cleanse the dipping spoon and the offering ladles; come forward with the clarified butter."

5.12.145.s: āhṛtāsu prokṣaṇīṣūdasya sphyaṃ mārjayitvedhmābarhir upasādya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyaṅṅ ādrutya sruvaṃ ca srucaś ca saṃmārṣṭi |
5.12.145.d: आहृतासु प्रोक्षणीषूदस्य स्फ्यं मार्जयित्वेध्माबर्हिर् उपसाद्य प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आद्रुत्य स्रुवं च स्रुचश् च संमार्ष्टि ।
5.12.145.m: When the sprinkling waters have been brought, having set aside the wooden sword, having cleansed [himself], having placed near the kindling wood and the sacrificial grass, having turned around clockwise, and having run westward, he cleanses the dipping spoon and the offering ladles.

5.12.145.s: ājyenodetyājyaṃ ca prokṣaṇīś cotpūya prasiddhaṃ pañcagṛhītāni vā ṣaḍgṛhītāni vājyāni gṛhītvā prokṣaṇībhir upottiṣṭhati |
5.12.145.d: आज्येनोदेत्याज्यं च प्रोक्षणीश् चोत्पूय प्रसिद्धं पञ्चगृहीतानि वा षड्गृहीतानि वाज्यानि गृहीत्वा प्रोक्षणीभिर् उपोत्तिष्ठति ।
5.12.145.m: Having come forward with the clarified butter, having purified the clarified butter and the sprinkling waters, having taken five or six ladlefuls of clarified butter in the established manner, he stands up with the sprinkling waters.

5.12.145.s: idhmaṃ prokṣati vediṃ prokṣati barhiḥ prokṣati
5.12.145.d: इध्मं प्रोक्षति वेदिं प्रोक्षति बर्हिः प्रोक्षति
5.12.145.m: He sprinkles the kindling wood; he sprinkles the altar; he sprinkles the sacrificial grass.

5.12.145.s: barhir āsannaṃ prokṣyopaninīya purastāt samūlaṃ prastaraṃ gṛhṇāti tūṣṇīm
5.12.145.d: बर्हिर् आसन्नं प्रोक्ष्योपनिनीय पुरस्तात् समूलं प्रस्तरं गृह्णाति तूष्णीम्
5.12.145.m: Having sprinkled the sacrificial grass brought near and having poured down [water], he silently takes the grass bundle with roots from the front.

5.12.145.s: atha prācīnāvītaṃ kṛtvā trir apasalaiḥ paristṛṇan paryeti
5.12.145.d: अथ प्राचीनावीतं कृत्वा त्रिर् अपसलैः परिस्तृणन् पर्येति
5.12.145.m: Then, having worn the sacred cord over the right shoulder [prācīnāvīta], he goes around strewing [the grass] thrice counter-clockwise.

5.12.145.s: saṃtarām evāgre | atha vitarām atha vitarām atha yajñopavītaṃ kṛtvā yathetaṃ triḥ punaḥ pratiparyeti |
5.12.145.d: संतराम् एवाग्रे । अथ वितराम् अथ वितराम् अथ यज्ञोपवीतं कृत्वा यथेतं त्रिः पुनः प्रतिपर्येति ।
5.12.145.m: Closer [to the fire] first, then further, then further; then, having worn the sacred thread over the left shoulder [yajñopavīta], he goes back around thrice as he had come.

5.12.145.s: atha prastarapāṇir dvau paridhī paridadhāti madhyamaṃ caiva dakṣiṇaṃ ca |
5.12.145.d: अथ प्रस्तरपाणिर् द्वौ परिधी परिदधाति मध्यमं चैव दक्षिणं च ।
5.12.145.m: Then, holding the grass bundle in his hand, he lays down two enclosing sticks: the middle one and the southern one.

5.12.145.s: ūrdhve samidhāv ādadhāti vidhṛtī tiraścī sādayati
5.12.145.d: ऊर्ध्वे समिधाव् आदधाति विधृती तिरश्ची सादयति
5.12.145.m: He places two upright kindling sticks; he places two separating blades crosswise.
Upon the two separating blades, he silently throws down the grass bundle with roots.

5.12.146.s: prastare juhūm | barhiṣītare etā asadan | iti samabhimṛśya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyaṅṅ ādrutyānupūrvam̐ havīm̐ṣy udvāsayaty upastīrṇābhighāritaṃ puroḍāśam abhighārya dhānāḥ karambham iti
5.12.146.d: प्रस्तरे जुहूम् । बर्हिषीतरे एता असदन् । इति समभिमृश्य प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आद्रुत्यानुपूर्वँ हवीँष्य् उद्वासयत्य् उपस्तीर्णाभिघारितं पुरोडाशम् अभिघार्य धानाः करम्भम् इति
5.12.146.m: On the grass bundle the juhū ladle; on the sacrificial grass the others; having touched them together with: "These have sat down," having turned around clockwise, having run westward, he takes off the oblations in order: having basted the cake that had been strewn under and basted over, the parched grains, [and] the porridge.
They bring them forward one after another.
To the south he sets down the cake; to the north the parched grains;

5.12.146.s: uttarataḥ karambham | dakṣiṇata etat pariśrayaṇaṃ kaśipūpabarhaṇe āñjanābhyañjane daśām̐ sphyam iti nidadhāti |
5.12.146.d: उत्तरतः करम्भम् । दक्षिणत एतत् परिश्रयणं कशिपूपबर्हणे आञ्जनाभ्यञ्जने दशाँ स्फ्यम् इति निदधाति ।
5.12.146.m: to the north the porridge; to the south he places down this enclosure, the mat and pillow, collyrium and ointment, the woolen fringe, and the wooden sword.

5.12.146.s: dakṣiṇata upaviśato brahmā ca yajamānaś cottarato 'dhvaryuś cāgnīdhraś ca ||
5.12.146.d: दक्षिणत उपविशतो ब्रह्मा च यजमानश् चोत्तरतो ऽध्वर्युश् चाग्नीध्रश् च ॥
5.12.146.m: To the south sit the brahman and the sacrificer, and to the north the adhvaryu priest and the āgnīdhra priest.

5.13.146.s: athedhmāt samidham ādadāna āha | agnaye devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ samidhyamānāyānubrūhi | iti |
5.13.146.d: अथेध्मात् समिधम् आददान आह । अग्नये देवेभ्यः पितृभ्यः समिध्यमानायानुब्रूहि । इति ।
5.13.146.m: Then, taking a kindling stick from the kindling wood, he says: "Recite for Agni being kindled for the gods, for the Pitṛs."

5.13.146.s: abhyādadhātīdhmam̐ sakṛd vā trir vā pari samidham̐ śinaṣṭi
5.13.146.d: अभ्यादधातीध्मँ सकृद् वा त्रिर् वा परि समिधँ शिनष्टि
5.13.146.m: He puts the kindling wood on [the fire] once or thrice; he leaves out one kindling stick.
He fans [the fire] with the broom; when the kindling verses have been recited, he pours the continuous libation with the dipping spoon.

5.13.146.s: saṃmṛṣṭe srugbhyām uttaram athāsam̐sparśayan srucāv udaṅṅ atyākramya juhvā dhruvām̐ samajya sādayitvā srucau pravaraṃ pravṛṇīte |
5.13.146.d: संमृष्टे स्रुग्भ्याम् उत्तरम् अथासँस्पर्शयन् स्रुचाव् उदङ्ङ् अत्याक्रम्य जुह्वा ध्रुवाँ समज्य सादयित्वा स्रुचौ प्रवरं प्रवृणीते ।
5.13.146.m: When [the altar] is wiped clean, [he pours] the subsequent [libation] with the two ladles; then, not letting the two ladles touch each other, having stepped across towards the north, having anointed the dhruvā ladle with the juhū ladle and having set down the two ladles, he chooses the ancestral invocation.

5.13.146.s: athāśrāvayati | o śrāvaya | astu śrauṣaṭ | agnir devo hotā devān pitṝn yakṣat sīda | ity etāvān pravaraḥ
5.13.146.d: अथाश्रावयति । ओ श्रावय । अस्तु श्रौषट् । अग्निर् देवो होता देवान् पितॄन् यक्षत् सीद । इत्य् एतावान् प्रवरः
5.13.146.m: Then he makes the call: "Make him hear!" "Let there be hearing!" "May the divine Hotṛ, Agni, worship the gods, the Pitṛs; sit down!" Such is the ancestral invocation.

5.13.146.s: sīdati hotā prasavam ākāṅkṣati prasūtaḥ srucāv ādāyātyākramyāśrāvyāha samidho yaja | iti
5.13.146.d: सीदति होता प्रसवम् आकाङ्क्षति प्रसूतः स्रुचाव् आदायात्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह समिधो यज । इति
5.13.146.m: The hotṛ priest sits down; he awaits the impulse; impelled, having taken the two ladles, having stepped across, and having made the call, he says: "Recite the offering verse for the kindling sticks."

5.13.146.s: yaja yaja | ity apabarhiṣaś caturaḥ prayājān iṣṭvodaṅṅ atyākramya sam̐srāveṇānupūrvam̐ havīm̐ṣy abhighārati |
5.13.146.d: यज यज । इत्य् अपबर्हिषश् चतुरः प्रयाजान् इष्ट्वोदङ्ङ् अत्याक्रम्य सँस्रावेणानुपूर्वँ हवीँष्य् अभिघारति ।
5.13.146.m: Having offered the four fore-offerings excluding the barhis [each time saying] "Yaja, yaja," he steps across to the north and successively bastes the oblations with the residue [of the butter].

5.13.147.m: Then he proceeds with the two butter portions, with: "For Agni," [and] "For Soma."

5.13.147.s: athodaṅṅ atyākramya yathāyatanam̐ srucau sādayitvā prācīnāvītāni kurvate
5.13.147.d: अथोदङ्ङ् अत्याक्रम्य यथायतनँ स्रुचौ सादयित्वा प्राचीनावीतानि कुर्वते
5.13.147.m: Then, having stepped across to the north and placed the two offering ladles in their proper positions, they wear their sacred threads over the right shoulder.

These officiating priests exchange places;
they transpose the oblations.

5.13.147.s: uttarataḥ puroḍāśam āsādayati dakṣiṇataḥ karambham āśaya eva dhānā bhavanti |
5.13.147.d: उत्तरतः पुरोडाशम् आसादयति दक्षिणतः करम्भम् आशय एव धाना भवन्ति ।

5.13.147.s: uttarata upaviśato brahmā ca yajamānaś ca dakṣiṇato 'dhvaryuś cāgnīdhraś ca |
5.13.147.d: उत्तरत उपविशतो ब्रह्मा च यजमानश् च दक्षिणतो ऽध्वर्युश् चाग्नीध्रश् च ।
5.13.147.m: The brahman and the sacrificer sit to the north, and the adhvaryu priest and the āgnīdhra priest sit to the south.

Then they enclose it with screens;
they make a door facing north for it.

5.13.147.s: sa yo balavām̐s tam āha | anenodakumbhena saṃtatayā dhārayā trir apasalaiḥ pariṣiñcan parīhi | iti
5.13.147.d: स यो बलवाँस् तम् आह । अनेनोदकुम्भेन संततया धारया त्रिर् अपसलैः परिषिञ्चन् परीहि । इति
5.13.147.m: He says to whichever [man] is strong: "Go around three times counter-clockwise, sprinkling with a continuous stream from this water-jar."

5.13.147.s: sa tathā karoti nidhāya kumbhaṃ yathetaṃ triḥ punaḥ pratiparyeti |
5.13.147.d: स तथा करोति निधाय कुम्भं यथेतं त्रिः पुनः प्रतिपर्येति ।
5.13.147.m:
He does so;
having set down the jar, he goes around three times in reverse, just as he had come.
Then, having made an under-layer [of butter], while cutting off from the front half of the puroḍāśa, he says:

5.14.147.s: somāya pitṛmate 'nu svadhā | iti pūrvārdhāt puroḍāśasyāvadyati
5.14.147.d: सोमाय पितृमते ऽनु स्वधा । इति पूर्वार्धात् पुरोडाशस्यावद्यति
5.14.147.m:
"Proclaim the svadhā for Soma accompanied by the Fathers!"
He cuts off [a portion] from the front half of the puroḍāśa;

5.14.147.s: pūrvārdhād dhānānām | pūrvārdhāt karambhasya | abhighārayati pratyanakti dakṣiṇato 'vadāyodaṅṅ atikrāmati |
5.14.147.d: पूर्वार्धाद् धानानाम् । पूर्वार्धात् करम्भस्य । अभिघारयति प्रत्यनक्ति दक्षिणतो ऽवदायोदङ्ङ् अतिक्रामति ।

5.14.147.s: o svadhā | ity āśrāvyati | astu svadhā | iti pratyāśrāvayati
5.14.147.d: ओ स्वधा । इत्य् आश्राव्यति । अस्तु स्वधा । इति प्रत्याश्रावयति
5.14.147.m:
He makes the call: "O svadhā!"
[The āgnīdhra] makes the counter-call: "Let there be svadhā!"

5.14.147.s: somaṃ pitṛmantam̐ svadhā kuru | iti ye svadhā | ity āgūr ye svadhāmahe | iti vā
5.14.147.d: सोमं पितृमन्तँ स्वधा कुरु । इति ये स्वधा । इत्य् आगूर् ये स्वधामहे । इति वा
5.14.147.m:
[He says:] "Recite the svadhā for Soma accompanied by the Fathers!"
"Ye svadhā" is the assent-formula, or "Ye svadhāmahe."

5.14.147.s: svadhā namas | iti vaṣaṭkaroti vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti |
5.14.147.d: स्वधा नमस् । इति वषट्करोति वषट्कृते जुहोति ।
5.14.147.m:
He utters the vaṣaṭ-call: "Svadhā namaḥ!"
When the vaṣaṭ-call is uttered, he offers.

5.14.148.s: athopastīrya madhyād dhānānām avadyann āha pitṛbhyo barhiṣadbhyo 'nu svadhā | iti
5.14.148.d: अथोपस्तीर्य मध्याद् धानानाम् अवद्यन्न् आह पितृभ्यो बर्हिषद्भ्यो ऽनु स्वधा । इति
5.14.148.m: Then, having made an under-layer, while cutting off from the middle of the parched grains, he says: "Proclaim the svadhā for the Fathers seated on the barhis!"

5.14.148.s: madhyād dhānānām avadyati madhyāt karambhasya madhyāt puroḍāśasya |
5.14.148.d: मध्याद् धानानाम् अवद्यति मध्यात् करम्भस्य मध्यात् पुरोडाशस्य ।

5.14.148.s: abhighārayati pratyanakti dakṣiṇato 'vadāyodaṅṅ atikrāmati |
5.14.148.d: अभिघारयति प्रत्यनक्ति दक्षिणतो ऽवदायोदङ्ङ् अतिक्रामति ।

5.14.148.s: o svadhā | ity āśrāvayati | astu svadhā | iti pratyāśrāvayati pitṝn barhiṣadaḥ svadhā kuru | iti
5.14.148.d: ओ स्वधा । इत्य् आश्रावयति । अस्तु स्वधा । इति प्रत्याश्रावयति पितॄन् बर्हिषदः स्वधा कुरु । इति
5.14.148.m:
He makes the call: "O svadhā!"
[The āgnīdhra] makes the counter-call: "Let there be svadhā!"
[He says:] "Recite the svadhā for the Fathers seated on the barhis!"

5.14.148.s: ye svadhā | ity āgūr ye svadhāmahe | iti vā
5.14.148.d: ये स्वधा । इत्य् आगूर् ये स्वधामहे । इति वा
5.14.148.m: "Ye svadhā" is the assent-formula, or "Ye svadhāmahe."

5.14.148.s: svadhā namas | iti vaṣaṭkaroti vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti | athopastīryāparārdhāt karambhasyāvadyann āha pitṛbhyo 'gniṣvāttebhyo 'nu svadhā | iti |
5.14.148.d: स्वधा नमस् । इति वषट्करोति वषट्कृते जुहोति । अथोपस्तीर्यापरार्धात् करम्भस्यावद्यन्न् आह पितृभ्यो ऽग्निष्वात्तेभ्यो ऽनु स्वधा । इति ।
5.14.148.m:
He utters the vaṣaṭ-call: "Svadhā namaḥ!"
When the vaṣaṭ-call is uttered, he offers.
Then, having made an under-layer, while cutting off from the rear half of the groats, he says: "Proclaim the svadhā for the Agniṣvātta Fathers!"

5.14.148.s: aparārdhāt karambhasyāvadyati |
5.14.148.d: अपरार्धात् करम्भस्यावद्यति ।
5.14.148.m: He cuts off [a portion] from the rear half of the groats;

5.14.148.s: aparārdhāt puroḍāśasya | aparārdhād dhānānām abhighārayati
5.14.148.d: अपरार्धात् पुरोडाशस्य । अपरार्धाद् धानानाम् अभिघारयति

5.14.148.s: pratyanakti dakṣiṇato 'vadāyodaṅṅ atikrāmati | o svadhā | ity āśrāvayati |
5.14.148.d: प्रत्यनक्ति दक्षिणतो ऽवदायोदङ्ङ् अतिक्रामति । ओ स्वधा । इत्य् आश्रावयति ।

5.14.148.s: astu svadhā | iti pratyāśrāvayati pitṝn agniṣvāttān svadhā kuru | iti
5.14.148.d: अस्तु स्वधा । इति प्रत्याश्रावयति पितॄन् अग्निष्वात्तान् स्वधा कुरु । इति
5.14.148.m:
[The āgnīdhra] makes the counter-call: "Let there be svadhā!"
[He says:] "Recite the svadhā for the Agniṣvātta Fathers!"

5.14.148.s: ye svadhā | ity āgūr ye svadhāmahe | iti vā svadhā namas | iti vaṣaṭkaroti
5.14.148.d: ये स्वधा । इत्य् आगूर् ये स्वधामहे । इति वा स्वधा नमस् । इति वषट्करोति
5.14.148.m:
"Ye svadhā" is the assent-formula, or "Ye svadhāmahe."
He utters the vaṣaṭ-call: "Svadhā namaḥ!"

5.14.148.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti | athopastīrya dakṣiṇārdhāt puroḍāśasyāvadyann āha | agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte 'nu svadhā | iti
5.14.148.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति । अथोपस्तीर्य दक्षिणार्धात् पुरोडाशस्यावद्यन्न् आह । अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्विष्टकृते ऽनु स्वधा । इति
5.14.148.m:
When the vaṣaṭ-call is uttered, he offers.
Then, having made an under-layer, while cutting off from the southern half of the puroḍāśa, he says: "Proclaim the svadhā for Agni Kavyavāhana Sviṣṭakṛt!"

5.14.148.s: dakṣiṇārdhāt puroḍāśasyāvadyati
5.14.148.d: दक्षिणार्धात् पुरोडाशस्यावद्यति
5.14.148.m: He cuts off [a portion] from the southern half of the puroḍāśa;

5.14.148.s: dakṣiṇārdhād dhānānām | dakṣiṇārdhāt karambhasya
5.14.148.d: दक्षिणार्धाद् धानानाम् । दक्षिणार्धात् करम्भस्य
5.14.148.m:
from the southern half of the parched grains;
from the southern half of the groats.

5.14.148.s: dvir abhighārayati na pratyanakti dakṣiṇato 'vadāyodaṅṅ atikrāmati |
5.14.148.d: द्विर् अभिघारयति न प्रत्यनक्ति दक्षिणतो ऽवदायोदङ्ङ् अतिक्रामति ।

5.14.148.s: o svadhā | ity āśrāvayati | astu svadhā | iti pratyāśrāvayati | agniṃ kavyavāhanam̐ sviṣṭakṛtam̐ svadhā kuru | iti
5.14.148.d: ओ स्वधा । इत्य् आश्रावयति । अस्तु स्वधा । इति प्रत्याश्रावयति । अग्निं कव्यवाहनँ स्विष्टकृतँ स्वधा कुरु । इति
5.14.148.m:
He makes the call: "O svadhā!"
[The āgnīdhra] makes the counter-call: "Let there be svadhā!"
[He says:] "Recite the svadhā for Agni Kavyavāhana Sviṣṭakṛt!"

5.14.148.s: ye svadhā | ity āgūr ye svadhāmahe | iti vā
5.14.148.d: ये स्वधा । इत्य् आगूर् ये स्वधामहे । इति वा
5.14.148.m: "Ye svadhā" is the assent-formula, or "Ye svadhāmahe."

5.14.148.s: svadhā namas | iti vaṣaṭkaroti vaṣaṭkṛte dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhe 'tihāya pūrvā āhutīr juhoti |
5.14.148.d: स्वधा नमस् । इति वषट्करोति वषट्कृते दक्षिणार्धपूर्वार्धे ऽतिहाय पूर्वा आहुतीर् जुहोति ।
5.14.148.m:
He utters the vaṣaṭ-call: "Svadhā namaḥ!"
When the vaṣaṭ-call is uttered, having crossed beyond the earlier oblations, he offers into the south-eastern half.

5.14.148.s: atraitan mekṣaṇam̐ śalākām ity agnāv anupraharati |
5.14.148.d: अत्रैतन् मेक्षणँ शलाकाम् इत्य् अग्नाव् अनुप्रहरति ।
5.14.148.m: At this point, he throws the stirring-stick [and] the splint into the fire.

5.14.148.s: athaine sam̐srāveṇābhijuhoti | atha dakṣiṇato 'tyākramya yathāyatanam̐ srucau sādayitvā yajñopavītāni kurvate
5.14.148.d: अथैने सँस्रावेणाभिजुहोति । अथ दक्षिणतो ऽत्याक्रम्य यथायतनँ स्रुचौ सादयित्वा यज्ञोपवीतानि कुर्वते
5.14.148.m:
Then he pours the residue [of the butter] over them.
Then, having stepped across to the south and placed the two offering ladles in their proper positions, they wear their sacred threads over the left shoulder.

5.14.148.s: viparikrāmanty eta ṛtvijas | vipariharanti havīm̐ṣi dakṣiṇataḥ puroḍāśam āsādayati |
